title: Degraded performance in versions `>=1.1.412`, worse with multiple threads
1.1.412 regression - `Type "TypeAliasType" cannot be assigned to type variable` when assigning generic with type alias to a `TypeForm`
Pyright hangs indefinitely when using wrapt > 2.0.0

fix_commits.subject: Fix hang in constraint solver for cyclic TypeVar lower bounds (#11413) (#11415)
fix_commits.body:
* Fix hang in constraint solver for cyclic TypeVar lower bounds (#11413)

When the constraint solver established a TypeVar's first lower bound, it
would unconditionally record the source type even when that source type
contained the destination TypeVar nested inside another generic
constructor (e.g. R := R | Awaitable[R], as produced when matching wrapt
2.1.x's wrap_function_wrapper against a generic make_wrapper). Each
subsequent round of solveAndApplyConstraints substituted R with its own
ever-growing bound, producing exponentially larger types and hanging the
analyzer.

Add an occurs check in assignUnconstrainedTypeVar: if adjSrcType
references destType at a strictly nested position, refuse the assignment
rather than recording a non-finitely-solvable constraint. Top-level
union members that are exactly the TypeVar (e.g. T := T | int from
protocol matching against T | int) are explicitly allowed and resolved
by the existing logic.

Adds a regression test (paramSpec56) that hangs without the fix and
completes in ~640ms with it.

* Apply prettier formatting

title: A `NewType`  is reported as "Class created with NewType" when used in `isinstance`

fix_commits.subject: Updated error message for `NewType` used in `isinstance` check. I don't think this makes things clearer, but it is technically more correct. Addresses #10601.

title: `(fn: Callable[P, ...]) -> ...` is considered fully overlapped by `(fn: Callable[[], ...]) -> ...`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive "fully overlapping overload" error when a second overload uses a Callable with a ParamSpec but the first does not. This addresses #10587. (#10588)

title: StrEnum and IntEnum values should not be subtypes of `Literal[<str>]` or `Literal[<int>]`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false negative when attempting to assign an IntEnum or StrEnum literal to the Literal type corresponding to its value type. This addresses #10552. (#10558)

title: Spec compliance regression
Type not resolved for generic TypedDict with `extra_items=T`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in incorrect behavior when a type variable is used to define the `extra_items` type for a generic TypedDict. This addresses #10545. (#10563)

title: `final` overrides not detected on methods decorated with `cache`

fix_commits.subject: Changed behavior when `@final` is applied to a method but subsequent decorators (like `@functools.cache` or `@property`) subsequently transform the method into a different type. The typing spec is not clear how this should work. Pyright now honors the `@final` in these cases, which is consistent with mypy. This addresses #10543. (#10578)

title: Bidirectional inference assigning symbols in other modules

fix_commits.subject: Fixed  bug that causes bidirectional type inference to be skipped when the target of an assignment is a member access expression (`base.member`) and the base expression is a module. This addresses #10539. (#10577)

title: Pyright crashes when using incorrect genric syntax with a TypeVarTuple and a TypeVar with a default value.
Regression in support for idiomatic TypedDict discrimination?

fix_commits.subject: Reverted narrowing behavior for discriminating between TypedDicts. This narrowing behavior isn't technically correct from a type safety standpoint, but until PEP 728 is accepted, it's the only practical way to do this form of discrimination. This addresses #10517. (#10579)

title: methods not assignable to `Protocol` with `__self__` property

fix_commits.subject: Improved modeling of bound and unbound methods so they properly use `types.MethodType` or `types.FunctionType`. This addresses #10514. (#10586)

title: `reportUnusedVariable` false positive

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive `reportUnusedVariable` error under specific conditions when an expression's local type has a circular dependency. This addresses #10512. (#10575)

title: a 'final' NamedTuple is flagged with pyright 1.1.401

fix_commits.subject: Fixed regression that resulted in a false positive error when using `reportUninitializedInstanceVariable` with a `NamedTuple` class. This addresses #10490. (#10791)

title: regression: "unecessary #type ignore" reported in stdlib
Implicit override warnings reported for _type_checker_internals.pyi
Incorrect return type inference when generic function is passed non-union value

fix_commits.subject: Added support for bidirectional type inference when assigning an expression to an unpacked tuple literal and all of the items in the tuple have a declared type. This addresses #10481. (#10585)

title: Error is not reported when TypeAliasType definition is cyclical

fix_commits.subject: Added missing check for unquoted self references when calling `TypeAliasType` constructor manually (as opposed to using the PEP 695 `type` syntax). This addresses #10475. (#10478)

title: false positive reportMatchNotExhaustive when all Literals are covered by types

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug in type narrowing logic for class patterns in a `match` statement. Negative type narrowing was incorrect when the subject is a literal type and the class is the corresponding non-literal class. This addresses #10473. (#10479)

title: Confusing type of local `__class__`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a spurious error when `__class__()` is assigned to `Self`. This addresses #10451. (#10452)

title: Issue type narrowing `Any | EllipsisType` with `x is ...`

fix_commits.subject: Enhanced `x is ...` type narrowing logic to  narrow `Any | EllipsisType` to `EllipsisType` to match `x is None` narrowing logic. This addresses #10443. (#10455)

title: Type narrowing failure on `tuple` of `Union`s

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in incorrect type narrowing behavior when the second argument to an `isinstance` call includes a union (specifically with the `|` operator) within a tuple expression. This addresses #10426. (#10429)

title: Regression: Type Confusion from Inline Class Naming

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in confusion between two classes defined in the same file with the same name but in different functions when they are used in protocol matching. This addresses #10418. (#10584)

title: Pyright not detecting instantiation of certain abstract classes

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false negative when deriving from a stdlib protocol class and not implementing one or more abstract methods. This addresses #10401. (#10402)

title: Unexpected error 'Second argument to "super" call must be object or class that derives from XX'

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive error under certain circumstances where the second argument for a `super` call is a union. This addresses #10388. (#10389)

title: False negative when accessing TypedDict with `extra_items=Never`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that leads to a false negative when accessing a key on a TypedDict that is defined with `extra_items=Never`. This addresses #10377. (#10379)

title: Incorrect type narrowing for TypedDicts using the `S in D` type guard pattern

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug in the type narrowing logic for the `S in D` type guard pattern (where S is a string literal and D is a TypedDict). If the TypedDict is not closed, the absence of the key within the TypedDict definition cannot eliminate the type during narrowing. This addresses #10376. (#10378)

title: Assigning descriptor instance to a class defining `__slots__` causes undesired type narrowing

fix_commits.subject: Improved handling of `__slots__` members to correctly model the case where a descriptor object is stored in a `__slots__` variable. This addresses #10370. (#10382)

title: Incorrect variance inference due to @property with a custom self: annotation

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in incorrect variance inference when a property access method uses a method-local type variable to annotate the `self` parameter. This addresses #10367. (#10387)

title: Pep 728 support for TypedDict with Unpack does not allow extra items

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive error when calling a function with an unpacked TypedDict with `extra_items` when additional keyword args are passed. This addresses #10352. (#10357)

title: Pyright - missing error details when assigning a dict comprehension

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in missing diagnostic details under certain circumstances where bidirectional type inference is attempted in the assignment of an attribute. This addresses #10345.

title: Nested type aliases in classes specialize prematurely

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a spurious "type already specialized" error when using a class-scoped type alias defined using a `type` statement or `TypeAliasType` constructor. This addresses #10330. (#10332)

title: Unable to assign an empty dictionary to a TypedDict with `total=False`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that causes bidirectional type inference not to be used in cases where a ternary expression is assigned to an annotated instance or class variable and the ternary condition narrows the type of `self` or `cls`. This addresses #10318. (#10321)

title: False positive "Access a generic instance variable"

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive when accessing a generic attribute from an object whose type is `type[X]`. This addresses #10304. (#10305)
Revert "Fixed bug that results in a false positive when accessing a generic attribute from an object whose type is `type[X]`. This addresses #10304. (#10305)"

title: Scope leak of comprehension variable after an `isintance` check

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in incorrect type narrowing of a variable that is shadowed in an inner-scoped comprehension. This addresses #10301. (#10306)

title: Pyright hangs when defining cyclic type alias with `Callable` type

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that leads to a hang when a generic type alias definition refers to itself. This addresses #10287. (#10334)

title: Callable type aliases without arguments defined in a class body are inaccurately(?) marked as a "reportAttributeAccessIssue"

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive error when referencing a class-scoped type alias defined as a callable. This addresses #10282. (#10308)

title: property-abstractmethod checking differs from non-property abstractmethod checking
if no argument `os._exit()` comes after `return`, pyright doesn't notice us

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false negative when a return statement contains a call expression that invokes a `NoReturn` call and the argument list contains errors. This addresses #10260. (#10264)

title: Types `object` and `Callable` are reported to not have any overlap.

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that leads to a false positive in the `reportUnnecessaryComparison` check when one operand's type is a callable and the other is not. This addresses #10253. (#10267)

title: Type checking is wrong with recursive asynchrone functions

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in an incorrect error under certain circumstances when inferring the return type of a recursive function that has a decorator or is `async`. This addresses #10242. (#10244)

title: Missing syntax error for "ru" (raw Unicode) string prefix

fix_commits.subject: Removed support for `ru` and `ur` string prefixes. These were supported in Python 2.7 but are syntax errors in Python 3.x. This addresses #10222. (#10223)

title: No error when providing more than one unpacked arbitrary-length tuple argument

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false negative when the specialization of a TypeVarTuple includes multiple unpacked tuples of unknown length. This addresses #10219. (#10220)

title: tuple unpacking succeeds, while splatting gives error

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive error under certain circumstances involving a type variable with an upper bound of `type[T]` that is assigned to another type variable. This addresses #10207. (#10210)

title: Namespace packages are always un-typed

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive "missing stub file" diagnostic when importing a "py.typed" submodule from a namespace package. This addresses #10203. (#10205)

title: False negative on incorrect override involving generic method

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false negative when a type variable with an upper bound is used to annotate a parameter in a method override. This addresses #10197. (#10199)

title: Regression numpy dtype incorrectly inferred when base class is unknown

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false negative when a class that derives from `type[Any]` is assigned to any other type. This addresses #10185. (#10224)

title: Callable is never an instance of class

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in incorrect type narrowing when a value whose type is a non-callable (and non-final) class is passed as the second argument to an `isinstance` call and the first argument is a callable type. In this case, a subclass could provide a compatible `__call__` method, so the type shouldn't be narrowed to `Never`. This addresses #10171. (#10179)

title: Incorrect literal math with modulo operations and negative numbers

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug in "literal math" logic for modulo and floor divide operators that affect cases where operands have different signs. This addresses #10167. (#10168)

title: Incorrect literal math with negative shift counts

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug in "literal math" for shift operators. If the RHS value is negative, the operation is invalid, so literal math shouldn't be applied. This addresses #10165. (#10166)

title: Incorrect literal math with zero dividend and negative divisor

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in incorrect "literal math" result when dividing `Literal[0]` by a negative literal int value. This addresses #10154. (#10157)
Fixed another regression related to literal math division. This addresses #10154. (#10158)

title: 1.1.396 -> 1.1.397:  Difference in dict() partially unknown in strict mode

fix_commits.subject: Fixed regression that results in an `Unknown` type evaluation where previously `Any` was generated during bidirectional type inference. This addresses #10128. (#10129)

title: Default value assignability in methods not checked anymore?

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression that results in a false negative when calling a function with a positional-only parameter whose type is generic and has a concrete default argument value. This addresses #10120. (#10130)

title: Incorrect value inference of `-N // +N`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in incorrect "literal math" results when using a floor divide `//` operator with literal operands whose signs differ. This addresses #10076. (#10079)

title: TypedDict generic parameter in a nested class structure reports an error

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in incorrect bidirectional type inference when using nested constructor calls for dataclasses. This addresses #10071. (#10072)

title: while/continue adds "unknown" to an otherwise unambiguously str-typed variable

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in an incorrect "Unknown" type evaluation under certain circumstances involving an assignment to an annotated variable within a loop. This addresses #10068. (#10069)

title: False negative for unpacked dictionary argument when callable is `Any`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that leads to a false negative when evaluating a call expression where the callable type is `Any` and an argument expression uses dictionary unpacking but the operands type is not a mapping. This addresses #10061. (#10066)

title: False negative for unpacked arguments

fix_commits.subject: Added code to enforce that an argument in a call expression that is unpacked is iterable. This addresses #10060. (#10077)

title: `__path__` is inferred an `Iterable[str]` rather than list

fix_commits.subject: Changed the type of `__path__` from `Iterable[str]` to `MutableSequence[str]`. Both are correct, but the latter is more precise. This addresses #10058. (#10062)

title: Toplevel `__init__.py` imports considered invalid if partial stubs are available and do not include it
Variable only used in format string reported as "is not accessed"

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in an identifier being marked "unaccessed" if it is used in an argument expression to a call whose type is possibly unbound. This addresses #10034. (#10036)

title: Bug with combination of contextmanager, partial, and ParamSpec

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a spurious type error when a ParamSpec is used in conjunction with a dataclass and a contextmanager. This addresses #10011. (#10125)

title: Overload resolution change/bug?
`numpy.arange` returns `Unknown` type with 1.1.395
Pyright runs indefinitely on GenericAlias manipulation

fix_commits.subject: Changed internal caching of inferred return types so it is shared among all types that derive from a given function. This reduces compute and memory consumption somewhat. It's also necessary (but not sufficient) to address #10000. (#10112)
Fixed a bug that results in a hang under certain circumstances when inferring the return type of a recursive function. This addresses #10000. (#10113)

title: Version 1.1.394 and 1.1.395 broke pandas-stubs
1.1.395: @overload decorator seems ignored
Error passing unpacked iterable into TypeVarTuple-typed varargs

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a spurious error when an unpacked iterable argument expression supplies the objects for an `*args` parameter that is annotated with an unpacked TypeVarTuple. This addresses #9980. (#9981)

title: Callable subtyping bug w/ positional-only params & unpacked *args

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in an incorrect error when determining assignability of a function with an `*args` that is unpacked using a `*tuple[]`. This addresses #9974. (#9975)

title: Multiple type guards make `type` unassignable to `type`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a spurious error when an `isinstance` or `issubclass` type guard results in a narrowed type that is synthesized as a subclass of `type` and some other class. This addresses #9971. (#9976)

title: Type inference of `defaultdict` fails when unpacking a `dict` with known value type

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in incorrect overload resolution when an unpacked argument is of unknown length and potentially matches multiple overloads. This addresses #9970. (#10131)

title: Regression: Support for Context Manger as a decorator is broken since 1.1.394
False error being identified in async code
Argument of type "X" cannot be assigned to parameter of type "X" despite cast

fix_commits.subject: Changed algorithm for applying type narrowing upon assignment when one or both of the declared type or assigned type contain "Any". This addresses bug #9953 and generally makes pyright's behavior more like mypy's in this regard. (#10134)

title: can't assign tuple(list[T]) to tuple[T, ...] in generic types

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in a spurious error under certain specific conditions involving a call to a function or method that doesn't have a return type and whose inferred return type is based on variables calculated in a loop. This addresses #9937. (#9940)
Improved robustness of solution for #9937. (#9941)

title: `TypedDict` silently accepts experimental PEP 728 arguments but ignores them

fix_commits.subject: Improved error reporting for PEP 728 features when `enableExperimentalFeatures` is not true. This addresses #9928.

title: False positive `reportIncompatibleMethodOverride` with version 1.1.394

fix_commits.subject: Exempted `__init__` from override checks even in the case when the override is an object (such as a context manager) rather than a function. This addresses #9925. (#9926)

title: Pyright parses `*args` overloads as kwargs?

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a spurious "overlapping overload" error if the second both overloads have an `*args` but the first has one or more additional positional parameters. This addresses #9916. (#9921)

title: `__init__` is not ignored if `__new__` has an explicit return type annotation of `Any`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in noncompliance with the typing spec when a `__new__` method has an explicit `Any` return type annotation. In this case, type checkers should assume that the return type of `__new__` is _not_ a subtype of the containing class and should therefore ignore the `__init__` method. This addresses #9909. (#9910)

title: extraneous reportArgumentType when calling super().__init__

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that leads to inconsistent behavior in certain cases involving the evaluation of a call whose target signature involves a parameter with a default argument value, notably where the type of the default value isn't assignable to the declared type of its parameter. This addresses #9901. (#9922)

Revert "Fixed bug that leads to inconsistent behavior in certain cases involving the evaluation of a call whose target signature involves a parameter with a default argument value, notably where the type of the default value isn't assignable to the declared type of its parameter. This addresses #9901. (#9922)"

Partially eliminated inconsistent error reporting when calling a function with a default argument that is not assignable to the declared parameter type. An error will still be reported in the case where the declared parameter type includes an unsolved type variable in most cases, but it will no longer be reported if the unsolved type variable is due to a pseudo-generic class. This addresses #9901. (#10028)

title: Type annotation in the for loop causes Unknown return values on method calls

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a spurious `reportUnknownArgumentType` error under certain circumstances. This addresses #9891. (#9927)

title: `final` consistency should not be enforced for `TypedDict` compatibility

fix_commits.subject: Removed errant check for `@final` consistency when it is applied to `TypedDict`. This addresses #9884. (#9885)

title: Regression with zip, loses type info

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression that affected the evaluation of calls that target certain overloads that include an `*args` parameter in the fallback (the last overload). In particular, this affected the `zip` constructor. This addresses #9876. (#9882)

title: Adding __slots__ to a function-like Protocol breaks support for function assigment to the Protocol

fix_commits.subject: Exempted `__slots__` symbol when determining whether a class is a callback protocol. This addresses #9878. (#9879)

title: "Tuple size mismatch" when unpacking a tuple to zero variables

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive error when assigning a tuple of indeterminate length to a zero-length tuple target. This addresses #9866. (#9867)

title: geopandas stubs are missing in the latest typeshed update
Augmented assignment do not affect 'public' type of symbols

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in incorrect type inference for unannotated variables (either local or class-scoped) that are the target of an augmented assignment. This addresses #9842. (#9846)

title: No `reveal_type` diagnostic for attributes assigned in starred expressions

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in incorrect inferred type for an instance or class variable assigned a value as part of a tuple expression target with an unpack operator (e.g. `a, *self.b = (1, 2, 3)`). This addresses #9841. (#9844)

title: Overlapping overload error is missing when multiple keyword parameters have default arguments

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that leads to a false negative when checking for partially overlapping overloads that have keyword parameters with default argument values. This addresses #9840. (#9852)

title: TypedDict error on items function

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in incorrect handling (and spurious errors) when accessing an attribute on a TypedDict that is shadowed by a TypedDict item. This addresses #9814. (#9822)

title: Assignability rule for unpacked kwargs is not enforced

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a spec conformance issue relating to callable assignability when the dest type uses an unpacked TypedDict and the source does not accept `**kwargs`. The typing spec indicates that this should fail because TypedDicts are not closed. This addresses #9807. (#9824)

title: False positive warning when poping from a open TypedDict

fix_commits.subject: Changed behavior of TypedDict to synthesize a fall-back overload for the `pop` method to handle the case where the caller passes a key name that is not specified in the TypedDict definition. This addresses #9805. (#9825)

title: Error states base class of TypedDict is closed but it isn't.

fix_commits.subject: Improved error message for TypedDict base classes that are not closed but specify an `extra_items`. Also added check for cases where `closed` and `extra_items` are both specified. This addresses #9804. (#9827)

title: False Positive `reportNoOverloadImplementation` after passing function through generics

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that causes a false positive "no overload implementation" error when a non-overloaded function uses a decorator that changes its type to a an overloaded function. This addresses #9803. (#9853)

title: False negative: override of `@final` property

fix_commits.subject: Added missing check for the override of a property that is marked `@final`. This addresses #9795. (#9862)

title: Pyright does not catch SyntaxError: unterminated f-string literal

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in false negative when a format string with a single quote has a newline character within it. This results in a syntax error at runtime. This addresses #9789. (#9856)

title: BUG:  upgrade `1.1.392` -> `1.1.393`: can not resolve `@overload` `__init__()`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed regression that resulted in a false positive error when evaluating a call expression that targets an overloaded method and one of the arguments is an enum with more than 64 members. This addresses #9784. (#9858)

title: Pre-Release Version 2025.1.101 produces false error

fix_commits.subject: Tweaked the algorithm for computing the complexity of a code flow graph to accommodate slightly larger graphs before giving up. This addresses #9778. (#9781)

title: Usage of `Final` in typed dictionaries and named tuples

fix_commits.subject: Added missing check for illegal use of `Final` within a TypedDict or NamedTuple definition. This addresses #9767. (#9773)

title: pyright doesn't respect the documented resolution order

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false negative when two import statements shadow the same symbol and an attribute is accessed between the two import statements. This addresses #9752. (#9755)

title: False negative: Use of variable in type expression is not reported if its type is a TypeVar or Self

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in false negative when a parameter is used within a type expression and the parameter's type is a TypeVar or Self. This addresses #9750. (#9751)

title: Overload with variadic is not preferred over non-variadic

fix_commits.subject: Modified the overload call evaluation logic to conform with the new proposed type specification rules regarding `*args` parameters. This addresses #9748. (#9760)

title: Enforce that `@override` or `@final` appear only on first overload

fix_commits.subject: Added code to conform with the new checks mandated in the typing spec for `@final` and `@override` applied to an overload. This addresses #9747. (#9757)

title: `@override` does not work correctly for overloaded method without implementation

fix_commits.subject: Added `@override` enforcement for an overloaded method that has no implementation. This addresses #9746.

title: Incorrect handling of Concatenate when used with generics and decorators

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in incorrect type evaluation when passing a function with a callable parameter that uses Concatenate plus ParamSpec to a function that accepts a callable with just a ParamSpec. This addresses #9742. (#9765)

title: Stack overflow found in Pylance telemetry

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a crash (due to infinite recursion) if an enum class uses a reference to an enum member in an annotation for that same enum member. This addresses #9740. (#9762)

title: Cannot determine type of function with too many redefinitions

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive "recursive type definition" error under certain circumstances when the number of declarations for a symbol exceeds the internal threshold of 16. This addresses #9721. (#9722)

fix_commits.body:
* main: (119 commits)
  pull-pylance-with-pyright-1.1.392-20250121-190415 (#9734)
  Updated typeshed stubs to the latest version.
  Fixed a bug that results in incorrect handling of a "bare" ClassVar annotation either with or without an assignment. This addresses #9720. (#9724)
  Fixed a bug that results in a false positive "recursive type definition" error under certain circumstances when the number of declarations for a symbol exceeds the internal threshold of 16. This addresses #9721. (#9722)

  pull-pylance-with-pyright-1.1.392-20250115-210905 (#9714)

  Fixed bug that results in an "incompatible method override" false negative when overriding a method that uses class-scoped type parameters with a method that uses method-scoped type parameters. This addresses #9405. (#9707)

fix_commits.subject: Backed out recent performance optimization that resulted in a regression for protocol matching in certain circumstances. This addresses #9153, #9132, and #9130. (#9164)

title: Type could not be determined because it refers to itself

fix_commits.subject: Fixed issue that results in a false positive "type could not be determined because it refers to itself" error caused by a false dependency due to narrowing logic. This may also improve type analysis performance in some code. This addresses #9139. (#9323)

title: Pyright 383 regression - reportArgumentType/npt.ArrayLike

fix_commits.subject: Backed out recent performance optimization that resulted in a regression for protocol matching in certain circumstances. This addresses #9153, #9132, and #9130. (#9164)

title: Numpy type checking false positive

fix_commits.subject: Backed out recent performance optimization that resulted in a regression for protocol matching in certain circumstances. This addresses #9153, #9132, and #9130. (#9164)

title: Investigate performance regression in hydra-zen

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a performance regression caused by a recent bug fix that affects variance inference for recursive type aliases. This addresses #9118. (#9119)

title: Regression for typing.Annotated when aliased

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug with the provisional `TypeForm` support that breaks aliases of `Annotated`. This addresses #9092. (#9095)

title: Allowing incorrect return type when doing arithmetic with Literal-bounded type

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that leads to incorrect type evaluation when "literal math" for unary operators are applied to a TypeVar value that has a literal value upper bound. This addresses #9090. (#9094)

title: Invalid parameter expression not reported and causes incorrect display of signatures.

fix_commits.subject: Fixed several bugs related to the explicit specialization of a generic type alias parameterized by a single ParamSpec. `Concatenate` was being handled incorrectly. This addresses #9088. (#9117)

title: Possible bug in variance inference for recursive type alias

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in incorrect variance inference for some generic type aliases that use auto variance and nested callable types. (#9102)
fix_commits.body:
Added the ability to view inferred variance for type aliases created with a `type` statement by hovering over the type parameter declaration.

This partly addresses #9081.

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in a false negative when assigning a specialized recursive generic type alias to itself when variance of its type parameters are not covariant. This addresses #9081. (#9103)

title: Error with dict literal as TypedDict argument with metaclass

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in incorrect type evaluation behaviors when a class has a custom metaclass with a `__call__` method and a `__new__` or `__init__` method that provides a different bidirectional type inference context for parameters. This addresses #9067. (#9071)

title: Property method "fget" is incompatible

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in a "reportIncompatibleMethodOverride" error being reported in the wrong location when a property method has a decorator applied to it. This addresses #9059. (#9060)

title: `Never` is not recognized as a subtype of `P` for `P` a type parameter

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive when assigning `Never` to a type variable in a contravariant context. This addresses #9056. (#9061)

title: Wrong inconsistency detected when overloading a function whose signature involves parametric types

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in false positive under certain circumstances involving classes parameterized with a contravariant type variable. This addresses #9054. (#9379)

title: TypeForm (sometimes) not treated as possible UnionType

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in incorrect type narrowing when a value typed as `TypeForm` is used as the first argument to `isinstance`. This addresses #9053.

title: Clarify intended behaviour of `reportAssertAlwaysTrue`

fix_commits.subject: Clarified documentation for `reportAssertAlwaysTrue`. This addresses #9050.

title: Unexpected interactions between unions and type parameters

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false negative when assigning a value to a union type that includes the same type variable multiple times in at least one invariant context. This change eliminates the concept of a "locked" constraint tracker, which is no longer needed and was the underlying cause of the bug. This addresses #9047. (#9048)

title: False positive when using an unpacked typed dict for variadic keyword arguments with a field overlapping a positional only argument

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that can result in a false positive error when a function signature contains a positional-only parameter and a keyword parameter with the same name. This can result from the application of a ParamSpec or through the use of an unpacked TypedDict. This addresses #9043 and #8964. (#9064)

title: Attributes with `attrs` converters show `__converterDescriptor_x` instead of type hint

fix_commits.subject: Improved hover text for converters in dataclass-like classes. This addresses #9041.

title: Pyright incorrectly reports arguments are writable in Protocol

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in false positive error when using a `Final` variable in a protocol and a NamedTuple or frozen dataclass as a concrete class. This addresses #9040.

title: type inference for objects of type list[Module] may not work

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in incorrect type inference for list, set, dict, and tuple expressions that include modules in them. This addresses #9036. (#9038)

title: A corner-case where type cannot be inferred

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that can result in incorrect type evaluation behaviors if a call to `type` is used within a loop. This addresses #9023. (#9024)

title: Pylance looses type when inside of for in

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in spurious "variable not allowed in type expression" errors when a type alias is used in a loop in both a type expression and a value expression. This addresses #9017. (#9018)

title: Potential bug with cancellation token handling
Cannot assign `cls.some_dict: [Hashable, t.Self]` in `__init_subclass__`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a confusing error message extension referencing a missing `__set__` method when assigning to a class variable that is not a descriptor object. This addresses #9011. (#9014)
Fixed a bug that results in a false positive type error and confusing error message when assigning to a class variable that uses `Self` in its type definition. This addresses #9011. (#9013)

title: 1.1.380 reports error when using generics and passing DataclassInstance to another method

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in incorrect type narrowing when `TypeIs` intersects `type[A]` with `type[B]`. Previously, pyright was producing `<subclass of type[A] and type[B]>` but now produces `type[<subclass of A and B>]`. This addresses #9002 and #9003. (#9005)

title: Inconsistent and unexpected intersection when using `TypeIs[Type[<something>]]`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in incorrect type narrowing when `TypeIs` intersects `type[A]` with `type[B]`. Previously, pyright was producing `<subclass of type[A] and type[B]>` but now produces `type[<subclass of A and B>]`. This addresses #9002 and #9003. (#9005)

title: 'venvPath' and 'venv' not working on VS Code extension of version 1.1.376 and newer
`[object Object]` in reportDeprecated error message
Possible Metaclass Type Guard Regression in 1.1.380

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression that results in incorrect type narrowing for `isinstance` in the negative case when using `type` as a filter. This addresses #8963 and #8988. (#8990)

title: Pyright hangs on code involving polymorphic functions

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a hang under certain very specific circumstances involving a protocol method that has been decorated in such a way that it can no longer be bound to the owning protocol class. This addresses #8987. (#10135)

title: False positive for `reportUnboundVariable`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in incorrect evaluation of a variable in a doubly-nested loop that is assigned a value in an assignment expression. This addresses #8979. (#8980)

title: File analysis runs indefinitely after upgrading to v2024.9.1
`type(Any)` fails to be assigned to type of `type[Any]` or `type[type]`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression that results in a false positive error when attempting to assign the expression `type(Any)` to type `type[Any]`. This addresses #8973. (#8976)

title: Wrong inference for pattern matching with custom tuple subclass with literal pattern

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in incorrect type narrowing for sequence patterns in the negative (fall-through) case when the subject is a tuple with an unbounded entry. This addresses #8967. (#8968)

title: `TypeIs` doesn't narrow on union of generics

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in incorrect narrowing of types for `TypeIs` user-defined type guard in certain cases when variable type is a union. This addresses #8966. (#8981)

title: Factory class method provided by a mixin can define a duplicated argument.

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that can result in a false positive error when a function signature contains a positional-only parameter and a keyword parameter with the same name. This can result from the application of a ParamSpec or through the use of an unpacked TypedDict. This addresses #9043 and #8964. (#9064)

title: narrowing regression for dataclass instances (1.1.380)

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression that results in incorrect type narrowing for `isinstance` in the negative case when using `type` as a filter. This addresses #8963 and #8988. (#8990)

title: `TypeIs` doesn't properly narrow callable

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in incorrect type narrowing for `TypeIs` when it is used with a `Callable` type form. This addresses #8951. (#8952)

title: Nested executionEnvironments roots are difficult to specify
Type error after undo
callable type guard narrows too aggressively

fix_commits.subject: Removed support for custom `callable` type guard pattern. Now that typeshed defines this with a `TypeIs`, we no longer require custom logic here. This addresses #8944. (#8954)

title: Pyright language server 1.1.378+ does not work if rootUri & workspaceFolders is null
Regression for `Annotated` aliases when used as value expression

fix_commits.subject: Changed behavior to allow a value with type `_AnnotatedAlias` to be used with an implicit `__getitem__` call even though this type is not documented or declared in typeshed. This addresses #8916.

title: Pyright incorrectly propagates overloads in higher-order functions

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in an incorrect type evaluation of a higher-order function that is passed an overloaded function. This addresses #8898. (#8900)

title: Match statement on a tuple of class/instance variables does not narrow their types in case bodies

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that causes incorrect type narrowing of expressions used within a tuple expression in the subject expression of a `match` statement. This addresses #8897. (#8899)

title: Dataclass field with `converter` reported as "(function)" rather than "(variable)"

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in confusing hover information for an attrs … (#8883)
fix_commits.body:
* Fixed a bug that results in confusing hover information for an attrs field that uses a converter. This addresses #8881.

* Restored previous behavior for modules.

title: TypeAliasType reference cycle errors depending on cycle declaration order

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in incorrect type evaluation when assigning a recursive type alias to a tuple or list. This addresses #8879.

title: Incorrect type narrowing for `x in y` pattern when `x` is `type[T]` and `y` is an iterable of class objects

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in incorrect type narrowing for the `in` (containment) operator when the filter includes class objects (instances of `type`). This addresses #8866. (#8935)

title: Possible regression on float/Decimal constructors

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression that results in a false positive error under very specific circumstances involving a function with a TypeVar used in both a contravariant and covariant context and combined by union with other types in the contravariant context. This addresses #8864. (#8906)

title: Higher-order function type variable regression in 1.1.376

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression that results in a false positive under certain specific circumstances involving higher-order functions that return generic callable types. This addresses #8852. (#8892)

title: Report at wrong line when using substitution decorator

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a `reportIncompatibleMethodOverride` diagnostic being reported in the wrong location in some cases involving decorators. This addresses #8842. (#8843)

title: False positive for `defaultdict(defaultdict)`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a recent regression that results in a false positive type error when converting certain constructors (such as for the class `defaultdict`) to a callable type. This addresses #8840. (#8890)

title: NamedTuple/dataclass special attribute __name__ incorrectly treated as immutable for matching protocols

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive error during protocol matching because writable class variables defined in a named tuple or a frozen dataclass were considered read-only. This addresses #8829. (#8896)

title: Crash with ParamSpec and overloaded function involved

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a crash in very specific circumstances that involve binding a method parameterized by a function-scoped ParamSpec. This addresses #8823. (#8824)

title: Incorrect "variable is not accessed" message

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in false negatives for errors in argument expressions used in a call to `functools.partial` in some cases. This same issue also causes symbols accessed in these arg expressions to not be marked as referenced. This addresses #8807. (#8809)

title: Python version logging is broken

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in incorrect logging of the pythonVersion string. This addresses #8798.

title: False positive `reportIndexIssue` for typings in `v1.1.376` when `pyproject.toml` contains `[tool.pyright]` section (even if this section is empty)
indirectly-imported recursive types causes type-identity confusion

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive error under very specific conditions involving a recursive type alias that is defined in terms of another type alias. This addresses #8784. (#8785)

title: Missing default values in synthesized `__init__` signature of dataclasses

fix_commits.subject: Changed type checking logic to retain a reference to default expressions in function signatures, including synthesized signatures (such as `__init__` methods in dataclasses). This allows the original default value expression to be printed in error messages and language server strings. This addresses #8781. (#8783)

title: False positive when decorator uses inner function with ParamSpec and inferred return type

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that leads to incorrect type evaluation in certain specific conditions involving a function decorator with an return type inferred from an inner function parameterized by a ParamSpec. This addresses #8779. (#8780)

title: Crash with `--threads` and `--pythonversion`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that leads to a crash when `--pythonversion` and `--threads` CLI options are used together. This addresses #8775. (#8776)

title: `TypeGuard[...]` is a subtype of  `bool` but not `int` since 1.1.374

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive error when assigning a `TypeGuard[T]` or `TypeIs[T]` to a supertype of `bool` (like `int`). This addresses #8769. (#8771)

title: Regression in v1.1.374 with two-argument form of `super()` **inside** a class

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a recent regression that results in incorrect type evaluation when using a two-argument form of `super()` and the second argument is `type[Self]`. This addresses #8763. (#8889)

title: Pyright incorrectly binds type variables in higher-order functions
Internal error occured: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'name')

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a crash under certain circumstances when a ParamSpec without a scope is used illegally to specialize a class. This addresses #8757. (#8768)

title: False positive with `Final` and read-only property in protocol

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that leads to false positive error when a protocol has a read-only property a class has a Final  variable. This addresses #8744. (#8747)

title: PythonPath from vscode-pyright is not settable if there is a pyrightconfig.json
Out of memory error under very specific circumstances

fix_commits.subject: Renamed some internal functions for readability and added options parameter to getEffectiveReturnType function. This is in preparation for a more involved change to fix #8723. (#8736)
Fixed bug that leads to a hang under certain circumstances involving deeply-nested higher-order functions. This addresses #8723. (#8752)

title: `diagnosticMode` is no longer defaulting to "openFilesOnly"
Lambda type error

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a false positive error when solving type variables in a call that involves a lambda. This addresses #8714. (#8730)

title: Bad signature when using `Unpack` with empty `TypedDict`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that produces signatures with extra (unnecessary) positional-only and keyword-only separators when using a TypedDict with zero fields. This addresses #8712.

title: type error on `map`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in unexpected constraint solver results in certain cases involving arguments with lambda expressions. This addresses #8697. (#9367)

title: Internal error when passing empty tuple to ParamSpec inside TypeAlias

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a crash when an empty tuple is used to specialize a generic type alias parameterized by a ParamSpec. This addresses #8694.

title: @lru_cache interferes with @overload'ed definitions

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive reportInconsistentOverload error when the implementation of the overload includes a decorator that changes the type of the implementation to a non-function type. This addresses #8692. (#8699)

title: TypeIs does not narrow type in some cases

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that leads to incorrect type narrowing with `isinstance` or `TypeIs` when the filter type (the second argument to `isinstance`) is a subclass of `type`. This addresses #8691 and #8686. (#8934)

title: typing.Literal with tuple argument not understood
Pyright 1.1.375 hangs on file with overloaded functions using Python 3.12 (PEP 695) generics

fix_commits.subject: Fixed regression that resulted in a hang when determining whether an overload implementation with generics was compatible with its overloads. This addresses #8687. (#8706)

title: Unsoundness with protocols for polymorphic functions

fix_commits.subject: Changed behavior for protocols that have methods with method-scoped type variables. These are no longer treated as free type variables during protocol matching, so they can be used to support rank-2 polymorphism. This behavior is not currently dictated by the typing spec, but it is more consistent with mypy. This addresses #8685. (#8751)

title: is_dataclass always evaluates to false with TypeVars

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that leads to incorrect type narrowing with `isinstance` or `TypeIs` when the filter type (the second argument to `isinstance`) is a subclass of `type`. This addresses #8691 and #8686. (#8934)

title: False negative when missing cases matching on union of enums

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug in type narrowing logic for value patterns, specifically when two enums with members of the same name are involved. This addresses #8674. (#8682)

title: Pyright incorrectly determines attribute in subclass overriding generic attribute in parent as type Never

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in incorrect type narrowing when using `isinstance` with an instance of a generic class as the first argument and a concrete subclass as the filter type. This addresses #8672. (#8675)

title: False positive when dict with literal keys unpacked as function args

fix_commits.subject: Enhanced argument-to-parameter matching logic to support dictionary unpacking where the dict key type is a union of literals. This addresses #8671. (#8724)

title: StrEnum annotation causes wrong unreachability diagnostic

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in incorrect type narrowing for truthy/falsy type guards consisting of an Enum member when the enum class derives from ReprEnum. In this case, the "magic" of the enum implementation forwards the `__bool__` call to the underlying value. This addresses #8658. (#8662)

title: String literal reported as "is not defined" generating `reportUndefinedVariable`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that caused first argument of `cast` method on `memoryview` object to be treated as a type expression. Pyright was confusing this method with `typing.cast`. This addresses #8649. (#8651)

title: Overload inference with `*args`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in incorrect overload matching when one overload contains a zero-arity variant and another overload contains an `*args` (variadic) parameter. This addresses #8645. (#8654)

title: Comparison with `Literal` `int`, `Literal` `Enum` and `frozenset` occupancy constrains value differently and sometimes incorrectly

fix_commits.subject: Added subtyping support or `IntEnum` and `StrEnum` members. These literal values are subtypes of the corresponding literal `int` or `str`. This partly addresses #8641.

title: `__all__.extend(...)` fails when the argument is an empty list

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive `reportUnsupportedDunderAll` warning when using the `__all__.extend(x.__all__)` form and the list of entries in `x` is empty. This addresses #8636.

title: False positive when using "reduce" with list of strings

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive error under certain circumstances when passing an overloaded function as an argument to a call. This addresses #8632. (#8644)

title: A regression allows to violate the Liskov substitution principle for arguments when overriding methods

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false negative `reportIncompatibleMethodOverride` when the child class method uses a type parameter that is scoped to the child class. This addresses #8622. (#8711)

title: `partial` does not play nicely with `Unpack`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug in the `functools.partial` logic that results in incorrect handling of an unpacked TypedDict when used with a `**kwargs` parameter. This addresses #8617. (#8630)

title: False positive when method-scoped covariant type variable is used in parameter annotation

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive error when a covariant type variable that is scoped to a method is used in a parameter annotation. This addresses #8614. (#8615)

title: "Nested[Y@ListTransform]" is not a subtype of "Nested[Y@ListTransform]"
Incorrect type inference after type narrowing

fix_commits.subject: Modified heuristics in `T is None` type narrowing logic to handle TypeVars with no bounds better. The previous logic was arguably correct, but it produced results that were unexpected by some users. This addresses #8575. (#8578)

title: PEP 702's `@deprecated`, `@overload`, and `__new__()`

fix_commits.subject: Added support for `@deprecated` on `__new__` methods used implicitly during a class constructor call. This addresses #8574.

title: `Final` should be disallowed in loops
`TypeIs[]` incorrectly narrows tuple with known length

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in incorrect type narrowing when tuples are used in conjunction with `TypeIs`. This addresses #8554. (#8559)

title: Generics Regression in 1.1.373

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression that results in a false positive error under certain circumstances when yield expression includes a call to a constructor. This addresses #8552. (#8553)

title: Annotating `Enum` attributes with `Final` causes surprising type violations

fix_commits.subject: Added error check for an enum attribute with a "naked" `Final` attribute. This should be considered invalid. This addresses #8543. (#8544)

title: `UnionType` instance not passable as generic parameter

fix_commits.subject: Eliminated error condition when using a subscript expression for a generic class that does not conform to type expression rules (e.g. `list[1 + 2]`) if the expression is a value expression. This addresses #8534. (#8537)

title: Use of `typing.Self` in `__init__`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a warning if the `self` parameter in an `__init__` method is given an explicit `Self` annotation. This addresses #8532. (#8533)

title: crash in createOptionalType()

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a crash if `Optional` is used with no subscript (i.e. `Optional[]`). This addresses #8524.

title: `TypeIs[x]` should be treated as a subtype of `bool`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug in logic that validates subtyping relationships between `TypeIs[T]`, `TypeGuard[T]` and `bool` when used in a return type of a callable. This addresses #8521. (#8523)
Fixed a bug that results in an incorrect "inconsistent overload" error when the overloads return `TypeIs` or `TypeGuard` and the implementation returns `bool`. This addresses #8521. (#8556)

title: `isinstance` narrowing incorrect for `object` filter

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug in `isinstance` type narrowing if the second argument is `object` and the first argument is a `type` instance. This addresses #8520. (#8527)

title: Regression in Pyright 1.1.373: valid union element disallowed

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression that results in a false positive error when evaluating certain nested constructor calls when used with bidirectional type inference. This addresses #8519. (#8535)

title: Pyright 373 regression - code unreachable

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression that results in incorrect `isinstance` type narrowing when the filter class and the type are both protocols. This addresses #8518. (#8529)

title: [PEP 728] "closed" `TypedDict` with `__extra_items__` cannot be type-checked correctly as an `TypedDict` attribute

fix_commits.subject: Added support for bidirectional type inference for `__extra_types__` in a closed TypedDict. This addresses #8503. (#8507)

title: Pylance fails with TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'nameWithScope')

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a crash in certain conditions involving a corrupt builtins.pyi stub. This addresses #8509.

title: `reportInconsistentConstructor` false negative

fix_commits.subject: Fixed issues with the `reportInconsistentConstructor`. It produced false negatives in some cases and produced bad error messages in other cases. This addresses #8501 and #8500. (#8502)

title: Imprecise error message for `reportInconsistentConstructor`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed issues with the `reportInconsistentConstructor`. It produced false negatives in some cases and produced bad error messages in other cases. This addresses #8501 and #8500. (#8502)

title: False Positive with Protocol Binding for Type Vars

fix_commits.subject: Added test case for #8494, which was already fixed by a previous commit.

title: Tuple with unpacked TypeVarTuple Param has incorrectly unioned last element

fix_commits.subject: Improved type evaluation for tuples index expressions with negative subscripts and an entry with an indeterminate length. This addresses #8485. (#8486)

title: reportOverlappingOverload disagrees with observed behavior

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive "overlapping overload" diagnostic when the later overload includes a callback function with a TypeVar in a parameter type. This addresses #8465. (#8484)

title: False positive error with bidirectional type inference for call expression

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive error when using bidirectional type inference for a call expression where the expected type is a union. This addresses #8449 and #8463. (#8468)

title: TypeIs does not narrow generics properly

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in incorrect type narrowing when using `TypeIs` form when the return type of the type guard function is a specialized generic class. This addresses #8460. (#8483)

title: `TypeVar` bound to `Annotated[...]` results in downstream false positives.

fix_commits.subject: Fixed regression that results in a false positive when an `Annotated` type is used in a type argument within a specialized type on the LHS of a call expression, such as `list[Annotated[int, ""]]()`. This addresses #8454. (#8455)

title: Union resolution fail with `Unknown` elements

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive error when using bidirectional type inference for a call expression where the expected type is a union. This addresses #8449 and #8463. (#8468)

title: A type error is being reported even though "type checking mode" is set to "off"

fix_commits.subject: Changed all diagnostic generated in the type evaluator to have a diagnostic rule associated with them so their severity is under user control. This addresses #8453. (#8456)

title: @overload fails for `__init_subclass__` when >=2 arguments are present

fix_commits.subject: Fixed false positive error when using an overloaded `__init_subclass__` method under certain circumstances. This addresses #8436. (#8439)

title: 'Never' doesn't work with Generic class

fix_commits.subject: Changed logic for explicit specialization to allow `Never` as a type argument for a value-constrained type parameter if `Never` is an explicit constraint. This addresses #8432. (#8438)

title: Type of dataclass Field.type incorrectly reported as Any | str

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in some circumstances in incorrect specialization of `type[T]` when `T` evaluates to `Any`. This addresses #8429. (#8431)

title: Logical OR Interpreted as union of literal values in some cases for `Final`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed inconsistent behavior when evaluating a binary expression with an `or` or `and` operator when the LHS evaluates to a literal `int`, `str`, `bytes` or `bool` type. This addresses #8417. (#8418)

title: Incorrect understanding of implicit namespace packages

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in incorrect import resolution behaviors when a ".py" file and a directory have the same name, and the directory doesn't have a `__init__.py` file in it. In this case, the ".py" file should take precedence during imports. This addresses #8408. (#8410)

title: reportOverlappingOverload when using Concatenate

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive `reportOverlappingOverload` error in certain cases involving `ParamSpec` and `Concatenate`. This addresses #8389. (#8393)

title: Inconsitstent typing of __doc__ in module and class

fix_commits.subject: Changed the type of the `__doc__` attribute for a module to always be `str | None`. Previously, pyright changed its declared type to `str` if a docstring was present in the module, but this is incorrect because it's a writable value and can be set to `None`. This addresses #8388. (#8397)

title: Regression: typing.NotRequired not working in typing.TypedDict

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a recent regression that results in a false positive when the fully-qualified form of `typing.Request` is used in an annotation expression. This addresses #8375. (#8381)

title: False positive inconsistent constructor if overloads are involved.

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in false positive `reportInconsistentConstructor` errors if one or both of `__init__` or `__new__` are overloaded. This addresses #8372. (#8383)

title: Imports resolution in Rye projects broke in 1.1.371
Type narrowing with assert and isinstance() doesn't work correctly for Union types

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that can result in incorrect evaluation of a traditional (pre-PEP 695) type alias the defines a union which is later used as the second argument to an `isinstance` or `issubclass` call. This addresses #8358. (#8362)

title: Add TypeVarTuple support for pattern matching with "*"

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug in type narrowing logic for sequence pattern matching when a "star" entry in the pattern captures a TypeVarTuple. The resulting type should be `Unknown` rather than the unpacked TypeVarTuple. (#8365)
fix_commits.body:
Fixed bug that results in a false positive when assigning type `tuple[Any, ...]` to `tuple[*TS]`. This should be allowed because `tuple[Any, ...]` is a gradual form that is assignable to all tuple types.

This addresses #8357.

title: `self` type is incorrect after isinstance call
Pyright v1.1.370 has incorrect min vscode engine version as 1.86

fix_commits.subject: Bumped min engine version from 1.86 to 1.89 to match the recently-updated language client library requirements. This addresses #8344.

title: Only first overload of `__init_subclass__` is matched against

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that causes a false positive error when an `__init_subclass__` has overloads. This addresses #8343.

title: Incorrect type evaluation of constructor call via generic type alias

fix_commits.subject: Fixed type evaluation of old-style (pre-PEP 695) type alias that aliases a generic class when it is used as a direct constructor call. This addresses #8337. (#8338)

title: Use of variables in type expression are sometimes not reported

fix_commits.subject: Improved detection of the use of variables used in type annotations. These are illegal according to the typing spec. (#8318)

title: Recognize Type Expressions in the Context of Generics

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive error when using a TypeVar with an upper bound of `type` as a base class in a `class` statement. This addresses #8313. (#8321)

title: Syntax error on valid python code

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive error when an unpack operator is used in an unparenthesized tuple expression on the RHS of an augmented assignment operator on Python 3.9 and newer. This addresses #8310.

title: Type narrowing with `isinstance()` doesn't work correctly for Union types

fix_commits.subject: Fixed regression that results in a false positive when a traditional type alias (not using PEP 695 syntax) defines a union and is then used as a second argument to an `isinstance` or `issubclass` call. This addresses #8302. (#8303)

title: False positive type error due to protocol insufficiently widened in function call

fix_commits.subject: Further simplification of the logic involved in type var solving. (#8600)

title: Decorator reported as untyped when unknown type appears

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive reportUntypedFunctionDecorator error under certain circumstances. This addresses #8298.

title: Paramspec checking issue

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false negative when passing an extra keyword argument to a callable that is parameterized with a ParamSpec. This addresses #8294. (#8299)

title: Spurious length mismatch errors for variadic generics (bidirectional inference?)

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in the incorrect default value of a variadic type variable when the type argument is not provided. It should default to `*tuple[Any, ...]`, not `*tuple[Any]`. This addresses #8285.

title: Pyright hangs when analyzing scipy project

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that can cause a hang during type analysis for complex code with loops. There are rare circumstances that can cause types not to converge due to symbol dependencies and unstable overload resolution. This change adds a hard limit on the number of attempts to converge types in a loop before giving up. It addresses #8279. (#8491)

title: Performance issue when analyzing aiohttp project

fix_commits.subject: Improved analysis performance for complex code flow graphs by adding a cache for reachability. This addresses #8276. (#8278)

title: Pyright hangs when analyzing mypy project

fix_commits.subject: Improved performance of type analysis by caching additional reachability information for code flow graphs. This addresses #8275. (#8281)

title: Pyright hangs when analyzing graphql project
Pyright hangs when analyzing isort project
TypeAlias bound forward reference to Generic class results in Undefined error
Catching error when function decorated by decorator with overload

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in false positive `reportInconsistentOverload` and `reportNoOverloadImplementation` errors when an overloaded decorator is applied to a non-overloaded function or method. This addresses #8246. (#8249)

title: class inferred as abstract when it isn't.

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive when a protocol includes a method implementation that conditionally raises `NotImplementedError`. This addresses #8245.

title: Attempt to narrow down type results in new types added into the mix in unexpected way

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in incorrect type `isinstance` or `issubclass` type narrowing when using a type variable with an upper bound that includes a promotion type. This addresses #8238. (#8243)

title: False positive for `tuple[Never] = (1,)`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in a false negative when assigning to type `tuple[Never]`. This addresses #8237.

title: Error occurred when creating type stub for sqlglot on first try
Strange Bug involving async

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression that results in false positive when a inner function with an inferred return type is a coroutine (async) and is referenced within the function body in which it's declared. This addresses #8232 and #8229. (#8251)

title: NamedTuple Subclass Thinking It Returns a Tuple

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in incorrect type narrowing on assignment if the narrowed type is `Self` or another bound type variable. This addresses #9147. (#9154)

title: Incorrect type inference when a lambda is conditionally reassigned

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression that results in false positive when a inner function with an inferred return type is a coroutine (async) and is referenced within the function body in which it's declared. This addresses #8232 and #8229. (#8251)

title: Pyright crashes starting from version 1.1.367

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression that results in an assertion failure (and therefore a crash) when `type()` is called with dynamic base classes. This addresses #8228.

title: inappropriate narrowing during `match` statement

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in incorrect type narrowing in the negative (fall-through) case of a match expression when the subject expression is an unbounded tuple. This addresses #8219.

title: false positive in `reportUnboundVariable`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that leads to a spurious "unbound variable" diagnostic when a variable is assigned a value using a walrus operator and is later used in a `**` call argument. This addresses #8218.

title: `foo = {hello := "world"}` reports `Operator ":=" is not allowed in this context without surrounding parentheses`

fix_commits.subject: Added support for walrus (assignment) operator within set literal expressions if the python version is >= 3.10. The grammar was changed in 3.10 to support this. This addresses #8216.

title: Incorrect compatibilities between `tuple[()]` and `tuple[object, ...]` in function overloads

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in an incorrect overload implementation diagnostic when using `tuple[()]` in overloads. This addresses #8194. (#8195)

title: Assertion in `computeMroLinearization` seen in Pylance telemetry

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression that results in a runtime assert (and therefore a crash) in certain circumstances when computing the MRO for a class. This addresses #8191.

title: Recent type alias enhancement does not always work

fix_commits.subject: Changed hover provider output for type aliases to conform more closely with the new Python 3.12 `type` syntax. This partially addresses #8185.
Improved handling of special forms, including TypeAliasType instances, when used in value expressions. This addresses #8185. (#8296)

title: False positive `reportUninitializedInstanceVariable` for `NamedTuple`s on v1.1.368

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression in `reportUninitializedInstanceVariable` check relating to `NamedTuple` instance variables. This addresses #8184.

title: Fails to type check argument to subscript operation

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that leads to a false negative when a subscript object used in an index expression supports `__index__` but the indexed object specifies that it requires `int`. This addresses #8183. (#8188)

title: Error message is misleading and not helpful when using descriptors

fix_commits.subject: Improved diagnostic messages for type errors detected during `__set__` and `__delete__` calls to a descriptor object. This addresses #8181. (#8198)

title: False positive error for function instantiating rank-2 structural type

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive error when using a callback protocol with a function-scoped type variable. This addresses #8177. (#8207)

title: Erroneous `reportArgumentType` with `ParamSpec` using `Callable` with `TypeVar` Argument

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that incorrectly evaluates a constructor call to a constructor that infers a class-scoped ParamSpec when the passed function is generic. This addresses #8170. (#8215)

Fixed bug that results in incorrect type evaluation of a function that accepts a Callable[P, T] and is passed a class object whose constructor needs to be converted to a callable. This addresses #8170. (#8258)

title: Revealed Type of Union of Generic TypedDict not a Union

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in unions consisting of different specialized forms of a generic TypedDict to "lose" all but one of these subtypes. This addresses #8169.

title: False negative with incompatible properties in subclass with multiple parents

fix_commits.subject: Added support for detecting mismatched property types in base classes used for multiple inheritance. This addresses #8167. (#8175)

title: TypeError when not assigning to intermediate variable.

fix_commits.subject: Added the distinction between "external" versus "internal" type variable scopes. This is important for generic class implementations that call their own constructors. (#8482)
fix_commits.body:
This is a significant change with high potential for regressions.

It addresses #8165, #7988, #7507, #7369.

title: `@deprecated()` stopped working since 1.1.364
`case Callable()` and match exhaustiveness

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug in pattern matching for `Callable()` in the negative (fall-through) case. This addresses #8160. (#8163)

title: pyright incorrectly synthesizes a `__dataclass_fields__` attribute for classes inheriting from `typing.NamedTuple`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in the incorrect synthesis of `__dataclass_fields__` for named tuples. This addresses #8152.

title: Inheriting class doesn't recognize kw_only=True from parent class

fix_commits.subject: Changed dataclass_transform behavior to allow dataclass behaviors (like `kw_only`) to be overridden by intermediate base classes. This addresses #8140. (#8141)

title: TypeEvaluator crashes due to Protocol usage with TypeVar(infer_variance=True)

fix_commits.subject: Fixed regression that results in an internal assertion (and crash) related to TypeVar variance inference. This addresses #8137.

title: Bare `type` member is inferred as Unknown

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that causes a "bare" `type` (with no type argument) or `type[Any]` to be treated as a possible descriptor object. This addresses #8136. (#8138)

title: Pyright raises type error when supplying an attr field with both default and a validator

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in inconsistent diagnostics when surrounding an argument expression with parentheses. This addresses part of #8133.
Fixed bug that results in false positive error under certain circumstances when solving type variables that involve literal values. This addresses #8133 and #8048. (#8603)

title: Double underscore module variables are ignored?

fix_commits.subject: Changed the behavior of double underscored symbols that are part of a module's namespace when that module is not a stub or in a "py.typed" package. Such symbols are no longer ignored, although they are considered private. This addresses #8131. (#8132)

title: Generator[None, Any, None] inferred incorrectly

fix_commits.subject: Changed inference behavior for generator functions with no reachable `yield` or `yield from` statements. The "yield type" (the first type argument to `Generator`) is now inferred as `Never` in this case rather than `None`. This addresses #8127. (#8130)

title: Regression: type information is not preserved when converting a constructor to a callable

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in parameter types being converted to `Any` when converting a `NewType` or dataclass constructor to a callable. This addresses #8116. (#8117)

title: Different behavior between `pyrightconfig.json` and `pyproject.toml`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that led to divergent behaviors between pyrightconfig.json and pyproject.toml configurations. Specifically, default exclude patterns were not added in the case of pyproject.toml. This addresses #8102.

title: Stdlib typeshed stubs should take precedence over `site-packages`

fix_commits.subject: Changed the import resolution order to better reflect runtime behavior and match a proposed change to the typing spec. In particular, stdlib typeshed stubs are now resolved prior to `site_packages`. This addresses #8099. (#8100)

title: `Final` is not honored when wrapped in `Annotated`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that causes `Final` annotation not to be honored when wrapped in an `Annotated` annotation. This addresses #8097.

title: Failure to resolve known type in loop involving tuple addition

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive error under certain circumstances involving tuple type narrowing in a loop. This addresses #8095. (#8098)

title: Type warning disappears after using `reveal_type` (+ false positive?)

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in incorrect (local) type evaluation of an instance variable with a declared type when assigned within a loop that uses an augmented assignment. This addresses #8090. (#8093)

title: False positive: Access to generic instance variable through class is ambiguous

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive when accessing a generic attribute in a base class from a subclass that explicitly specializes the generic type. This addresses #8083. (#8086)

title: `@enum.verify(enum.UNIQUE)` fails with "error: Argument of type "str" cannot be assigned to parameter"

fix_commits.subject: Updated typeshed stubs to the latest version. This addresses #8079.

title: Type narrowing based on truthyness can be broken for enum Literals if `__bool__` is overridden

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in incorrect truthy/falsy type narrowing for an enum that overrides `__bool__`. This addresses #8074.

title: Annotated attributes in Enum should be treated as non-members even in stubs

fix_commits.subject: Changed behavior of pyright to match the latest typing spec when it encounters an attribute with a type annotation within an `Enum` class body in a stub. These are now treated as non-member attributes rather than members. Typeshed stubs have been updated to conform to the new standard. This addresses #8061. (#8063)

title: Should reject the use of a type annotation for enum members

fix_commits.subject: Added diagnostic check for an enum member with a type annotation. The typing spec says that this should be considered a typing error. This addresses #8060. (#8069)

title: Error in positive type narrowing for `x is E` type narrowing pattern
