fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug in `x is E` type narrowing pattern where `E` is an enum literal and `x` is a supertype of `E` like `object`. This addresses #8059. (#8062)

title: walrus-assignment inference differs from single-assignment inference

fix_commits.subject: Issue8054 (#8055)
fix_commits.body:
* Fixed bug that results in a false negative when solving a type variable that involves an invariant context.

* Fixed a bug that can result in incorrect type inference for a subexpression that is part of an assignment expression if executed with an inference context (bidirectional type inference). This addresses #8054.

title: False positive error when solving for TypeVar

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in false positive error under certain circumstances when solving type variables that involve literal values. This addresses #8133 and #8048. (#8603)

title: Pyright runs forever on an identity function being called with a tuple containing two references of itself as argument

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in an infinite loop when evaluating a call that passes the same call as an argument. Simplified tracking of unique signatures within the code. This addresses #8047. (#8488)

title: `--createstub` outputs one extra colon

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a confusing error message when stub generation fails. This addresses #8044.

title: Missing argument is not reported if other argument contains a type error

fix_commits.subject: Changed behavior of constructor call evaluation when `__new__` evaluation results in type evaluation errors. Previously, pyright skipped the `__init__` evaluation in this case. It now proceeds to evaluate `__init__`, potentially generating redundant errors. This addresses #8026. (#8029)

title: False negative when assigning class constants inside __init__

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false negative when a `Final` class variable is assigned a value in the class body and reassigned a value in the `__init__` method. This addresses #8013. (#8015)

title: Type hinting for tuples

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that leads to inconsistent narrowing-on-assignment behavior when a `tuple` instance with unknown type arguments is assigned to a target symbol with a declared `tuple` type. This addresses #8001. (#8005)

title: Different inferred type `t = tuple(); list(t)` and `list(tuple())`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in an unsolved TypeVar when calling `list(tuple())`. This addresses #7998. (#7999)

title: Generic types are reused / only bound once

fix_commits.subject: Added the distinction between "external" versus "internal" type variable scopes. This is important for generic class implementations that call their own constructors. (#8482)
fix_commits.body:
This is a significant change with high potential for regressions.

It addresses #8165, #7988, #7507, #7369.

title: reportOverlappingOverload false positive: variadic tuple unpacking

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in incorrect type compatibility checks for a… (#7994)
fix_commits.body:
* Fixed a bug that results in incorrect type compatibility checks for a callable that uses `*args: *tuple[T, *tuple[S, ...]]`. This addresses #7987.

* Improved diagnostic messages for parameter mismatch.

title: StrEnum `value` property type regression

fix_commits.subject: Fixed regression that results in the incorrect type evaluation for the `value` attribute of a `StrEnum` or `IntEnum` class. This addresses #7983.

title: `ClassVar[Final[T]]` should be allowed for dataclasses

fix_commits.subject: Added support for recent addendum to typing spec that provides a special case for dataclasses so `ClassVar` and `Final` can be used together to distinguish between a regular `Final` instance variable and a `ClassVar` that is also `Final`. This addresses #7959. (#7962)

title: Incorrect type evaluated for `TypeIs[type[T]]`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in incorrect type narrowing for a type guard function that uses `TypeIs[type[T]]`. This addresses #7946. (#7947)

title: Overload is not reported as inconsistend when positional or keyword arguments are missing in implementation

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false negative when determining if a callable type is compatible with another callable type and the first has a `*args` parameter and the second has a single positional+keyword parameter. This addresses #7937. (#7938)

title: Debug failure for invalid type alias statement

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false negative syntax error when a PEP-695 type alias uses a keyword as a name. This addresses #7933.

title: reportArgumentType when passing `type` annotated parameter to `super()`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that leads to a false positive error when first argument to `super` call is an instance of a metaclass. This addresses #7931.

title: Enum Literal Handling Regression

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression that results in a false positive when accessing an enum member from an instance of an enum class. This addresses #7926.

title: Enum Nonmember Attribute Access Regression
Enum type matching issues in pyright `1.1.363`
Different behavior when switching arguments using same generic type?
Global private variables cause `reportPrivateUsage` error when used in classes

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that causes a false positive `reportPrivateUsage` error when a global or nonlocal binding is used within a class to access an outer-scoped variable. This addresses #7884.

title: Diagnostics for `reportUnnecessaryTypeIgnoreComment` are not marked as such

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in diagnostics associated with the `reportUnnecessaryTypeIgnoreComment` check to not include the error code. This addresses #7883.

title: Unnecessary comparison false positive with union of Coroutine and None

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive `reportUnnecessaryComparison` when a variable is used in a conditional expression and its type is a union that includes a `Coroutine` and a non-coroutine. This addresses #7881. (#7885)

title: Regression: ParamSpec and TypeVarTuple default values result in strange `assert_type` error

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression that results in `assert_type` failure when a class is parameterized by a ParamSpec with a default value. This addresses #7878.

title: aliases from other modules are incorrectly marked as deprecated when `deprecateTypingAliases` is enabled if the alias has the same name as a deprecated alias

fix_commits.subject: Fixed false positive `deprecatedTypingAliases` deprecation for `collections.abc.AbstractSet` due to a recent change in typeshed stubs. This addresses #7875.

title: TypeVars are lost when passed through some type-preserving operations

fix_commits.subject: Improved handling of constrained TypeVars when used with unary operators. This addresses #7874. (#7900)

title: Generic function expecting type parameter can't figure out type when Literal has only one parameter

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in a false negative when a `Literal` with multiple arguments is used in a value expression. It should be treated as a `UnionType` special form in this case. This addresses #7870.

title: Regression: ParamSpec are missing when using on args condition check

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression that resulted in incorrect type narrowing when a `*args: P.args` parameter was used in the expression `len(args) >= x`. This addresses #7866.

title: Odd type narrowing for variable length tuples in value dependent if statements

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in incorrect type narrowing for a tuple with determinate length when indexed with an out-of-bounds slice. This addresses #7864. (#7901)

title: Incorrect type narrowing for isinstance when filter is a generic class with a type parameter that has a default

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in incorrect type narrowing for `isinstance` or `issubclass` type guard when the filter is a generic class whose type parameter has a default value. (#7905)

title: Attributes annotated with a TypeVar with a default lead to Unknown types in pattern matching

fix_commits.subject: Fixed incorrect type narrowing for a class pattern argument if the class is a generic whose type parameters have default values. This addresses #7855. (#7857)

title: Old-style annotation weirdness

fix_commits.subject: Fixed false positive when a TypeVar appears within a function type comment. This addresses #7854. (#7856)

title: `(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any)` should be treated as `...` in function definition

fix_commits.subject: Changed interpretation of function definitions with (*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) to be `...` in compliance with latest typing spec. This addresses #7848. (#7859)

title: ReportUnnecessaryComparison bogus error 2

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in incorrect type evaluation for a variable that uses a nonlocal or global binding within an inner scope. Such a variable should never honor the narrowed type from the outer scope. This addresses #7838. (#7846)

title: Regression: Add "else" branches support for TypeIs

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression with the `TypeIs` type guard that resulted in incorrect type narrowing in the negative (else) case. This addresses #7837. (#7845)

title: Pyright crashes with internal error

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a crashing bug that results from an internal assertion failure when a generic class that uses PEP 695 syntax is located within an unreachable code block. This addresses #7828.

title: Incorrect pattern matching behaviour when matching tuples of arbitrary length

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in incorrect type narrowing when a `match` statement uses an empty (zero-element) sequence pattern and the subject expression type is a tuple that potentially (but does not always) have a zero length. This addresses #7826.

title: [match-case] Incorrect narrowing of types.

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in incorrect type narrowing in the negative (fall-through) case when a `match` statement includes a class pattern with a runtime-checkable protocol class. This addresses #7823. (#7829)

title: Pyright fails to bind function arguments to type var tuple

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in false positive when evaluating a function call involving a TypeVarTuple under certain circumstances. This addresses #7820. (#7917)

title: Missing keyword parameters for `__init_subclass__` of an ABC not caught

fix_commits.subject: Added special-case handling for `__init_subclass__` checks for classes that have `ABCMeta` as a metaclass. Previously, these were exempted from `__init_subclass__` because `ABCMeta` has a custom `__new__` method, but we know that this metaclass calls through to `type.__new__` which calls `__init_subclass__`. This addresses #7819. (#7871)

title: Performance regression

fix_commits.subject: Addressed a performance issue when indexing into a value that has a type consisting of a union of many (dozens or hundreds) of tuple types. This addresses #7813.

title: hover type for `type` of type aliases is incorrect

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that produces incorrect output when converting to a textual representation the type `type[Foo]` where `Foo` is a type alias. This addresses #7806. (#7809)

title: Regression: Using PEP-695 type variables causes scoping issues

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in incorrect evaluation of an identifier used in a method parameter type annotation if it shadows a forward reference in a class scope when the method is using PEP 695 type parameters. This addresses #7800.

title: Parse error with backslash before indented block

fix_commits.subject: Changed the tokenizer so it is bug-for-bug compatible with the CPython tokenizer in versions 3.10 and newer in the case where a backslash (continuation character) is located by itself on a line. This addresses #7799.

title: No error on reassigning Final vars in class bodies

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a false negative that occurs when reassigning a `Final` variable within a class body. This addresses #7797. (#7801)

title: [match-case] Object of type "Callable" is not callable

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive error when `Callable()` is used as a class pattern and the subject type is `Any` or `Unknown`. This addresses #7794. (#7796)

title: Pyright hanging with unannotated script

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to poor performance (effectively a hang) if an unannotated function is called through many (greater than 8) call expressions within a loop using different literal-value arguments each time. This addresses #7791. (#7792)

title: `reportMissingTypeStubs` default value is incorrect in some places

fix_commits.subject: Fixed documentation and json schema for `reportMissingTypeStubs` default. This addresses #7789.

title: Infinite loop (and OOM later) with datetype library

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that leads to an infinite loop when performing protocol matching under certain circumstances that involve recursive protocol definitions. This addresses #7786.

title: Spurious error when using closed `TypedDict` with `__extra_items__`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive error when using `__extra_items__` (PEP 728) with a `TypedDict` imported from `typing_extensions`. This addresses #7784.

title: Type annotation on global mutable variable is ignored

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in incorrect type evaluation when a global (module-scoped) variable is captured within an inner scope and the variable is not modified anywhere below the inner scope. It's possible in this case for the variable to be modified by code outside of the module. This addresses #7780. (#7803)

title: Generator lambda breaks its preceding function

fix_commits.subject: Issue7779 (#7781)
fix_commits.body:
* Changed `TypeIs` to use the same logic as `isinstance` type narrowing logic for consistency. This addresses #7767, #7760, and #7647.

* Fixed bug that results in a false positive error when a `yield` statement is used within a lambda following a function. This addresses #7779.

title: Parameter erroneously marked as unused

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false negative when using bidirectional type inference to evaluate the type of a lambda expression if the expected type is a union of two or more callables. This addresses #7772. (#7773)

title: `collections.namedtuple`/`typing.NamedTuple` bug: Customized synthetic constructor being `__init__` instead of `__new__` causes multiple issues when subclassing

fix_commits.subject: Changed logic that synthesizes the constructor methods for a NamedTuple subclass (using the class syntax) so the `__new__` method contains parameters based on field names and the `__init__` method contains a general `*args: Any, **kwargs: Any` parameter signature. Previously, this was swapped, but the new way is more faithful to the runtime. This addresses #7769.

title: pyright's `collections.namedtuple` model erroneously synthesizes `keys` and `items` methods

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug caused by incorrect synthesis of `item` and `keys` attributes for named tuple classes. This addresses #7768. (#7775)

title: Possible bug when using `TypeIs`

fix_commits.subject: Changed `TypeIs` to use the same logic as `isinstance` type narrowing logic for consistency. This addresses #7767, #7760, and #7647. (#7777)
Issue7779 (#7781)
fix_commits.body:
* Changed `TypeIs` to use the same logic as `isinstance` type narrowing logic for consistency. This addresses #7767, #7760, and #7647.

* Fixed bug that results in a false positive error when a `yield` statement is used within a lambda following a function. This addresses #7779.

title: Bug: `AsyncExitStack` with default typevar check failed when used in union type

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in incorrect bidirectional type inference when calling a constructor for a generic class that defines no `__new__` or `__init__` method. This addresses #7764. (#7776)

title: Incorrect type when `Enum` member references other `Enum` member in initalization

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in incorrect type evaluation behavior within c… (#7912)
fix_commits.body:
* Fixed bug that results in incorrect type evaluation behavior within class body of an enum class when one enum member is used to define another enum member. This involved a significant rewrite of the logic involving enum symbol evaluation. It addresses #7763.

* Add recursion protection.

title: `TypeIs` narrows constrained type variable to `Never`

fix_commits.subject: Changed `TypeIs` to use the same logic as `isinstance` type narrowing logic for consistency. This addresses #7767, #7760, and #7647. (#7777)
Issue7779 (#7781)
fix_commits.body:
* Changed `TypeIs` to use the same logic as `isinstance` type narrowing logic for consistency. This addresses #7767, #7760, and #7647.

* Fixed bug that results in a false positive error when a `yield` statement is used within a lambda following a function. This addresses #7779.

title: Operator issue with sqlalchemy.func
Incorrect type inference in dict comprehension with union return value

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive error when bidirectional type inference is used for a dictionary comprehension when the expected type is a union. This addresses #7741. (#7751)

title: Regression:  property of complex decorator fails.

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive error when a decorator is applied to a property. This addresses #7740. (#7913)

title: String-form generic parameter in base class list not recognized with PEP 695 syntax

fix_commits.subject: Redesigned the handling of PEP 695-style type parameter scoping to better match the CPython runtime implementation. This addresses #7716 and #7737. (#7754)

title: Bug when using protocols with callable fields

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug in protocol matching that results in a false positive when the subject object is a dataclass that contains a callable. It should be considered an instance member in this case, so it should not be bound to the class. This addresses #7735. (#7749)

title: Regression: ParamSpec type narrowing

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression that incorrectly narrowed the type of `kwargs` when used in a type guard of the form `if "a" in kwargs`. This addresses #7731. (#7747)

title: Regression: Generic decorator breaks the inference of complex types with unions

fix_commits.subject: Changed the TypeVar scoping behavior for TypeVars that appear only within a Callable subtype within a function's declared return type. Previously, pyright scoped these TypeVars to the Callable rather than the function. This was due to issue #4285. I'm reversing this decision because it's not spec-compliant, creates a bunch of unnecessary complexity, and results in buggy behavior. This addresses #7722. (#7918)

title: False negative when passing an arbitrary value to a function that takes an argument of type `T`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that leads to a false negative when calling a callback function that returns a callable with a generic parameter type. This addresses #7718. (#7965)

title: Regression: Constructor call logic incorrect when metaclass __call__ is unannotated

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression that affected unannotated `__call__` methods in a metaclass. This change aligns pyright's behavior to the typing spec. It addresses #7717. (#7746)

title: Regression: Incorrect error when using PEP 695 syntax

fix_commits.subject: Redesigned the handling of PEP 695-style type parameter scoping to better match the CPython runtime implementation. This addresses #7716 and #7737. (#7754)

title: Access to TypedDict NotRequired fields is not checked inside with statement

fix_commits.subject: Changed behavior to no longer exempt unguarded access to not-required TypedDict member within a `try` or `with` block. Previously, such errors were exempt, but this is inconsistent with other type checks in pyright which eschew the practice of using exception handling for normal code flow. This addresses #7714. (#7748)

title: `converter` type in attrs not correctly passed on to `__init__`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed regression related to "converter" field parameter for dataclasses when the converter refers to a generic class constructor. This addresses #7713.

title: dataclass subclass incorrectly inheriting default fields (false negative)

fix_commits.subject: Added a check for the case where a frozen dataclass overrides a field from its parent class but doesn't provide a default value (where its parent does). This can result in a type violation if the parent's default value is not compatible with the child's (covariant) field type. This addresses #7702. (#7704)

title: generic constructors as arguments are unchecked
False Negative SyntaxError with unparenthesized assignment expression in dictionary expression/comprehension

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that leads to a false negative when an unparenthesized assignment expression is used in a dictionary key within a dictionary expression or comprehension. This addresses #7694. (#7696)

title: When converting class to callable, annotated type of `__init__` should be honored

fix_commits.subject: Changed behavior of conversion from class constructor to callable to conform to honor the annotated type of `self` in the `__init__` method. This addresses #7688. (#7699)

title: When converting class to callable, return type should take into account return type of `__new__`

fix_commits.subject: Changed behavior of conversion from class constructor to callable to conform to honor return type of the `__new__` method. This addresses #7687. (#7701)

title: When converting class to callable, pyright doesn't honor non-standard `__new__` return type

fix_commits.subject: Changed behavior of conversion from class constructor to callable to conform with the typing spec in the case where the `__new__` method of the class returns a value that indicates the `__init__` method should be ignored. This addresses #7686. (#7698)

title: When converting class to callable, metaclass `__call__` is not taken into consideration

fix_commits.subject: Updated logic for converting a class constructor to a callable to conform to the newly-updated typing spec. This addresses #7684 and #7685. (#7693)

title: When converting a class to a callable, both `__new__` and `__init__` methods should contribute

fix_commits.subject: Updated logic for converting a class constructor to a callable to conform to the newly-updated typing spec. This addresses #7684 and #7685. (#7693)

title: Class-scoped TypeVars should not be allowed in `self` annotation in `__init__` method

fix_commits.subject: Added missing check for the errant use of class-scoped type variables in a type annotation for the "self" parameter within an "__init__" method. The typing spec now clarifies that this is illegal and should generate an error. This addresses #7683. (#7691)

title: Annotated type of `self` in `__init__` method should affect resulting type

fix_commits.subject: Modified handling of annotated `self` parameter in `__init__` method when evaluating constructor call so pyright conforms to the latest typing spec. This addresses #7682. (#7690)

title: Pydantic's TypeAdapter usage shows reportAbstractUsage error

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a spurious `reportAbstractUsage` error when an abstract class is captured through a `type[T]`. This addresses #7680. (#7681)

title: False positive undefined in function generic bounds

fix_commits.subject: Changed behavior when evaluating the upper bound expression, value constraints expression, or default expression for a PEP-695 type parameter. At runtime, these are always evaluated in a deferred manner even if they are not quoted. Pyright now follows the runtime behavior. This addresses #7678.

title: Adding `@property` to already decorated method leads to errors

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression that results in a false positive error when applying a `@property` decorator to a method that has already had a decorator applied to it. This addresses #7667. (#7671)

title: Weird behavior when type annotating a class member variable

fix_commits.subject: Improved some diagnostic messages, moving away from the term "member" to prefer "attribute". This partly addresses #7664.

Fixed a bug that leads to inconsistent behaviors when an assignment leads to a type violation. When assigning to a local variable, the target expression is not "narrowed" to include the assigned type in this case. The new behavior applies this same behavior when assigning to instance or class variables. This addresses #7664. (#7669)

title: Multiple errors with subclass of a Generic class paramterized by ParamSpec
`TypeIs` returns `Never` instead of intersection type

fix_commits.subject: Changed `TypeIs` to use the same logic as `isinstance` type narrowing logic for consistency. This addresses #7767, #7760, and #7647. (#7777)
Issue7779 (#7781)
fix_commits.body:
* Changed `TypeIs` to use the same logic as `isinstance` type narrowing logic for consistency. This addresses #7767, #7760, and #7647.

* Fixed bug that results in a false positive error when a `yield` statement is used within a lambda following a function. This addresses #7779.

title: Incorrect error when quoted type annotation is an f-string

fix_commits.subject: Improved error handling for quoted annotations. Bytes, raw strings, and f-strings are not allowed according to the typing spec. This addresses #7640. (#7641)

title: Type checks: failure to infer type after match statement when returning from specific case statements

fix_commits.subject: Added support for narrowing of subject subexpression within a match statement for references to the subexpression after the completion of the match statement. This addresses #7620. (#7621)

title: Type checking breaks on Enum private name mangling

fix_commits.subject: Modified the handling of enum class attributes so those with private (mangled) names are exempted from being considered enum members. This reflects the runtime behavior. This addresses #7619.

title: Bad performance with TypedDicts and unions

fix_commits.subject: Added optimization for TypedDict type assignments. Under certain circumstances (e.g. when comparing large unions of TypedDict types), this can save significant time. This addresses #7617.

title: `TypeIs` should be treated as invariant

fix_commits.subject: Fixed non-compliance issue with `TypeIs`, which is documented to have an invariant type parameter. This addresses #7615.

title: Incorrect type inference involving unpacked tuple in match statement

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in incorrect type evaluation when a sequence pattern in a `match` statement includes a `*` element and the subject includes a tuple with an element with indeterminate length. This addresses #7613. (#7616)

title: Function return type "None" is incompatible with type "_T@submit" in v2024.4.1

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in incorrect inferred parameter types for an unannotated method in a subclass when the parent class method contains function-scoped TypeVars. This addresses #7606.

title: pyright fails to recognize key existence in `TypedDict`s within class methods

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a type not being narrowed when using the `K in TD` type guard pattern (where `TD` is a TypedDict and `K` is a literal key). Narrowing was skipped if the RHS operand was not a simple identifier. This addresses #7589.

title: Pyright fails to bind function arguments to `*tuple[...]`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive error when an unpacked TypeVarTuple is used in a function defined with PEP-695 syntax. This addresses #7588. (#7599)

title: list comprehension turning `Literal` into `str`, but not `list()`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed inconsistent handling of literal values in a list comprehension. This addresses #7586. (#7598)

title: Incorrect type inference of dict expression that uses dictionary expansion of a TypedDict

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a type hole when a dictionary expression includes a dictionary expansion operator that acts on a non-closed TypedDict. This addresses #7577. (#7582)

title: Structural pattern matching ignores zero-valued flags of enum.Flag with strict mode

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in incorrect type narrowing of enums that derive from `enum.Flag`. In this case, we can't use enum expansion to a union of literals. This addresses #7576. (#7580)

title: __new__() cannot be called on a dataclass class

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive error when explicitly calling `__new__` on a dataclass, namedtuple, or TypedDict. These classes all require synthesized `__new__` methods. This addresses #7567.

title: Wrong overload chosen for TypeVarTuple callbacks with Literal

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive error under certain circumstances when a TypeVar or TypeVarTuple is being solved with literal values in both an invariant and non-invariant context. This addresses #7562. (#7629)

title: Misleading `reportImplicitOverride` when deriving from a class with unknown parent

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive `reportImplicitOverride` diagnostic if the class derives from an Unknown or Any class. This addresses #7560.

title: Pyright regression with dagster metaclass config

fix_commits.subject: Changed the logic for metaclass instance variable lookups to ignore the lookup if the metaclass MRO contains an unknown class. This addresses #7556.

title: TypeVar default refers to variables that are out of scope

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive when a class-scoped TypeVar used within a method has a default that refers to another class-scoped TypeVar. This addresses #7553. (#7554)

title: Protocol pattern matching non-exhaustive

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in incorrect type narrowing in the negative (fall-through) case when a runtime-checkable protocol class is used as a class pattern with arguments within a match statement. This addresses #7550. (#7552)

title: `Literal` objects misinterpreted within collections / mappings

fix_commits.subject: Improved type printer (the component that converts an internal type to textual format for diagnostic messages) so it better handles special forms like `Literal` or unions when used in a value expression. This partly addresses #7547.
Added support for using `Literal` and various other special forms in a value expression. This addresses #7547. (#7969)

title: False negative in typevar passed to generic function with not compatible type

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false negative when a generic function returns a Callable type that is specialized to include a live (in-scope) type variable. This addresses #7542. (#7634)

title: PEP 695 type alias is not fully supported when pointing to a type string with params

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in a false positive error if a PEP-695 `type` statement uses a type parameter and encloses the RHS in quotes. This addresses #7538.

title: `type:` comments work in other methods but not where defined

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in inconsistent type narrowing on assignment based on whether the assignment occurs within the same statement that includes the (declared) type annotation for the variable and whether the type annotation is provided as a type comment. This addresses #7537. (#7638)

title: Potential scoping issue when using TypeVar defaults in a class

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive error when a class-scoped TypeVar with a default that references another class-scoped TypeVar is used in a method signature in that class. This addresses #7525.

title: dataclass: Type of "<parameter>" could not be determined because it refers to itself

fix_commits.subject: Added accessor method for class symbol table. This is in preparation for a bug fix for #7516.
Fixed bug that results in an intermittent false positive "circular dependency" error for fields within a dataclass. This addresses #7516. (#7625)

title: Metaclasses using `Unpack[TypedDict]` for kwargs does not work as intended

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in false positive error when a `__new__` method in a metaclass uses PEP 692 (unpacked TypeDict) to annotate its `**kwargs` parameter. This addresses #7514. (#7518)

title: Constructor call within generic class confuses type arguments

fix_commits.subject: Added the distinction between "external" versus "internal" type variable scopes. This is important for generic class implementations that call their own constructors. (#8482)
fix_commits.body:
This is a significant change with high potential for regressions.

It addresses #8165, #7988, #7507, #7369.

title: Overloaded decorator using TypeVarTuple gets reported as not consistent with overloads.

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive error in certain circumstances involving a TypeVarTuple used within an overload. This addresses #7502.

title: list display vs MutableSequence argument

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in false positive when a list or set expression is evaluated using bidirectional type inference when the expected type is `MutableSet` or `MutableSequence`. This addresses #7498. (#7499)

title: Regression for `@classmethod` type variable inference in 1.1.354

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in false positive when implicitly specializing a class parameterized by a TypeVarTuple when there is no default. This addresses #7489. (#7491)

title: False negative for specifying non-tuple `Sequence[type[Exception]]` with `except*`

fix_commits.subject: Improved validation for `except` and `except*` statements to catch some previously-undetected invalid cases. This addresses #7483. (#7500)

title: Confusion between parenthesis and generator if inside a list comprehension

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in incorrect type evaluation if a list expression includes a generator expression. This addresses #7481.

title: `reportIncompatibleMethodOverride` false negative when subclass uses variable-length argument `*args`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false negative when overriding a method that has keyword parameters with a method that has a `*args` parameter. This addresses #7480. (#7501)

title: reportIncompatibleMethodOverride when subclass uses a property defined with setter

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive error when a base class defines a writable property and a subclass writes to the property. This addresses #7478.

title: False positive when checking consistency of **kwargs and positional arguments

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive "overload implementation does not match overloads" diagnostic when positional-only and keyword-only parameters are involved. This addresses #7473.

title: type from type checker is different to the type displayed on hover

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug in the code flow engine that results in incorrect type evaluation in certain cases involving codependent variables in a loop. This addresses #7466. (#7945)

title: False report on InstrumentedAttribute (sqlalchemy field) is not a hashable

fix_commits.subject: Added new `reportUnhashable` diagnostic rule. This addresses #7462. (#7464)

title: `reportInvalidTypeForm` false positive when using `TypeAlias` to `Never` with `__future__.annotations`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive under certain circumstances when defining a type alias using the old `typing.TypeAlias` annotation. This addresses #7457. (#7458)

title: Missing check for ClassVar mismatch when a non-protocol derives from a protocol

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false negative when a class explicitly inherits from a protocol that defines an instance variable but the child re-declares as a `ClassVar` without an explicit type. This addresses #7455. (#7463)

title: Numeric types are not strictly constrained in type variables

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in false negative when narrowing a constrained or bound TypeVar with a `complex()` or `float()` class pattern. This addresses #7449.

title: False positive when TypeVar default references another constrained TypeVar

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in a false positive under certain circumstances when a constrained TypeVar is used as the default for another constrained TypeVar. This addresses #7446.

title: Generic class parameterized by TypeVar with default isn't specialized for attribute access

fix_commits.subject: Changed the behavior when accessing a class attribute from a generic class that is not specialized. The class is now automatically specialized in the case using default type parameter values (from PEP 696) or Unknown. This change is required for conformance with PEP 696. It addresses #7445. (#7454)

title: False positive error when evaluating generic class or type alias with TypeVarTuple followed by ParamSpec with default

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in false positive when a generic class or type alias uses a TypeVarTuple followed by one or more ParamSpecs that have default values. This addresses #7444.

title: Generic class or type alias that uses a TypeVarTuple followed by a TypeVar with a default value should be rejected

fix_commits.subject: Added check for generic classes and type aliases that include a TypeVarTuple followed by a TypeVar that has a default value. This is illegal according to PEP 696. This addresses #7443.

title: Constants can be redefined without Warning using the 'def' Keyword

fix_commits.subject: Fixed two bugs that resulted in false negatives when redefining a constant variable with a non-variable symbol and when redefining a Final variable with a non-variable symbol. This addresses #7440.

title: pyright uses system locale regardless of envvars

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that made locale overrides through environment variables no longer work on node 21. This change removes the ability to override the localized language through the use of the global `navigator` object. This previously applied only to browser, but now node 21 supports this, which means that pyright users had no way to override it. If the pylance team wants localization to work in a browser, they'll need to find a better way to abstract this so it doesn't break pyright. This addresses #7439.

title: [reportCallIssue] False positive with metaclass

fix_commits.subject: Enhanced handling of `type` function when it is passed a class. Pyright previously evaluated this as `Any`, but now it returns the class' metaclass. This addresses #7437.

title: ReportUnnecessaryComparison bogus error

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in an incorrect type evaluation when an augmented assignment is used within an inner-scoped function to add a constant to a variable. Literal math should not be used in this case. This addresses #7431. (#7436)

title: `isinstance` check against a tuple that contains a union does not narrow types

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug in the `isinstance` type guard logic. It was not properly handling tuples that included unions. This addresses #7422.

title: Union: Unpack is not allowed in this context

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive when `Union` and `Unpack` are used outside of a type expression. Normal type expression rules should not be applied in this case. This addresses #7416. (#9135)

title: Strange type inference bug with unions and ifs

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in incorrect type narrowing behavior for member access expressions under certain circumstances. This addresses #7414. (#7426)

title: __package__ is not typed correctly

fix_commits.subject: Fixed hard-coded type information for module attribute `__package__`. It should be `str | None` rather than `str`. This addresses #7408. (#7409)

title: Constructors only return `() -> None` instead of function signature and docstring

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a regression that caused the signature help provider to not display the `__new__` method of a constructor if it is overloaded. This addresses #7405.

title: Weird recognition of type with generic mixin class

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive in a complex situation that involves generic protocols, properties, and mix-in classes. This addresses #7400. (#7506)

title: Invisible distinction between `*Shape` and `*tuple[*Shape]` causes spurious type errors

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive error when expanding the type arguments to a TypeVarTuple under certain circumstances. This addresses #7389. (#7390)

title: pyright type inference tripped up by @contextlib.contextmanager

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in incorrect type evaluation in cases where a generic function returns a callable, and the function is called with a higher-order generic function as an argument. This addresses #7386. (#7630)

title: False negative reportPossiblyUnboundVariable after pattern matching and enclosing scope

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in a false negative when a possibly-unbound variable is captured by an inner scope under certain circumstances. This addresses #7384. (#7427)

title: NewType(Annotated..., ...) is not being flagged

fix_commits.subject: Added check for inappropriate use of `Annotated` passed as second argument to `NewType` call. This addresses #7383.

title: Narrowing of list items does not work inside a loop that uses += on them

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in incorrect type evaluation when an index expression is assigned a value within a doubly-nested loop under certain circumstances. This addresses #7381.

title: Incompatible method override not detected in for `__call__`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false negative when a dundered method overrides a base class method of the same name and uses different parameter names along with different types. This addresses #7373. (#7376)

title: metaclass instance variable should be seen as class ClassVar

fix_commits.subject: Improved support for instance variables whose type is declared in a metaclass. Pyright now honors this type and enforces type consistency in derived classes. This addresses #7372. (#7387)

title: False positive reportPossiblyUnboundVariable after pattern matching, inside a loop

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that leads to a false positive error when a `match` statement is used in a loop and the subject expression is potentially narrowed as a result of the `match` statement. This addresses #7371. (#7377)

title: Type checking problem with generic `__init__()` of generic class.

fix_commits.subject: Added the distinction between "external" versus "internal" type variable scopes. This is important for generic class implementations that call their own constructors. (#8482)
fix_commits.body:
This is a significant change with high potential for regressions.

It addresses #8165, #7988, #7507, #7369.

title: v.1.1.352 breaks on node.js v12
PyRight rejects function with `TypeVar` parameterized generic type and arguments referencing the same `TypeVar` variables
Special form `InitVar` not flagged as error when used with `TypeAlias`
Enum nonmembers not supported

fix_commits.subject: Improved handling of `enum.nonmember` in cases where the attribute has a declared type. This addresses #7346.

title: Constructor generated by dataclasses fail to bind type vars on lambda statements in function fields.

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that leads to incorrect type inference for a lambda when passed to a constructor in certain circumstances. This addresses #7326.

title: pyright emits warnings from ignored paths

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in "reportUnnecessaryTypeIgnoreComment" diagnostics to be generated even if the source file was in the "ignore" list. This addresses #7325.

title: Pyright Not Reporting reportMissingModuleSource Error for typing_extensions Imports

fix_commits.subject: Added special-case handling for 'typing_extensions' module whose stubs are part of typeshed's stdlib stubs even though it is not part of stdlib. This addresses #7318.

title: Regression: False positive where variable with type of TypeVar does not respect the fact that it's been narrowed

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that leads to a false positive type violation when reassigning a value within a loop and the target variable has a declared type of a constrained type variable. This addresses #7302. (#7340)

title: Cast of annotated type is incorrectly reporting unnecessary cast

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive with the `reportUnnecessaryCast` check if the second argument is a special form. This addresses #7294.

title: Ambiguous Typing for Default Lambda Arg when using Generics

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to incorrect type evaluation for a call that targets a generic function that uses a default argument for one of the generic parameters. This addresses #7291. (#7296)

title: False negative when function uses a default argument for a generic parameter

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false negative when a generic function has a parameter with a generic type and a default argument value. This could lead to a typing hole when considering subtyping rules for callables. This addresses #7288. (#7954)

title: `update` in `TypedDict`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive error when calling `update` on a TypedDict with zero defined entries. This addresses #7289.

title: Tuple size mismatch for TypeVarTuple regression introduced in 1.1.340

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive error when assigning a tuple value that includes an unpacked TypeVarTuple to another tuple that also includes an unpacked TypeVarTuple. This addresses #7285. (#7287)

title: No type narrowing of subtypes in the match statement

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug in the type narrowing logic for class pattern matching that resulted in incorrect narrowing in the negative (fall-through) case. This addresses #7280. (#7283)

title: reportUnknownArgumentType false positive assigning empty list to a subscript of a list

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a false positive `reportUnknownArgumentType` error when assigning an empty list or dict expression to an index expression subscripted with a slice. This addresses #7278. (#7286)

title: Positional-only parameters make errors about unpacking dicts mysteriously disappear

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false negative when passing an unpacked dict of the wrong type to a function that contains a positional-only parameter marker plus one or more keyword parameters. This addresses #7271. (#7341)

title: Pyright Complains when Providing Inferred Annotation for `enum.nonmember`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive error when a `enum.nonmember` value is assigned to a class-scoped variable with a type annotation in an Enum class. This addresses #7265. (#7266)

title: False positive error when class uses metaclass that derives from `Unknown`

fix_commits.subject: Change the heuristic for determining whether a metaclass supports `__or__`. In the case where the metaclass derives from Any or Unknown, pyright now assumes that it doesn't override `__or__`.  This addresses #7260.

title: Pyright incorrectly rejects overriden methods in named tuple subclasses

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive error when a method defined within a named tuple is overridden by a subclass. This addresses #7256. (#7259)

title: Custom `IntEnum` class overloading `__new__` not working correctly

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a recent regression that results in a false positive error when an `Enum` subclass overrides `__new__` or `__init__` and then a subclass of that class assigns tuple values when defining enum members. This addresses #7252. (#7253)

title: Out of memory error when passing a generic function into a generic callable protocol

fix_commits.subject: Added test case for #7250, which was fixed by the same fix for #7141.

title: Bad type inference when calling the same generic function twice in one statement

fix_commits.subject: Refined the heuristic for when to use bidirectional type inference for the RHS of `and` and `or` operators. This addresses #7245. (#7348)

title: Type hint error when module and class shares the same name

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug in the import resolver that resulted in an incorrect resolution when an import within a `__init__.py` file uses the form `from .a import a`. This addresses #7233. (#7360)

title: Type error with partial and trio

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive error when an `await` expression is passed as an argument to an overloaded function. This addresses #7222.

title: Copying signature from an overloaded function results in error

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive "no overload implementation" error if an overloaded function is passed through a decorator that uses a ParamSpec. This addresses #7221. (#7246)

title: Unexpected unbound variable with loop, nested if, and attribute usage

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in an incorrect "Unbound" type evaluation for a variable assigned within a loop. This addresses #7217. (#7361)

title: Pyright fails to bind contravariant generic type in generic function

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive error under certain circumstances involving a call to a higher-order generic function with another function that involves a class with a contravariant type variable. This addresses #7212.

title: Defined variables become unbound in unreachable code

fix_commits.subject: Improved handling of unreachability analysis for an "implied else" (an if/elif chain that is missing a final "else" clause). This addresses #7189. (#7191)

title: Bug in alias annotations

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive error when a TypeVar bound to a union of literals is used in the specialization of a TypeAlias whose TypeVar is bound to a wider union of literals. This addresses #7184. (#7187)

title: no error when spreading possibly `None` value as a function argument

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false negative when a `None` type is in… (#7176)
fix_commits.body:
* Fixed a bug that results in a false negative when a `None` type is included in an unpacked argument within a function call. This addresses #7175.

* Improved logic for unpacked arguments that contain an "Unbound" type.

title: Type `unknown` with TypeVar default and overload

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in an incorrect type evaluation when a TypeVar with a default (PEP 696) was used in an overload but was not solved. This addresses #7173. (#7174)

title: Type error when calling methods of protocol superclass

fix_commits.subject: Changed behavior of `super()` method call when `self` is annotated as a protocol class. This pattern is used for annotating mix-ins. In this case, pyright should not generate an error if the protocol's method isn't implemented. This addresses #7160. (#7168)

title: IntelliSense is not reactive with sympy

fix_commits.subject: Changed tuple expression inference behavior to not preserve literal entry types if the tuple expression is embedded within another tuple, set, list, or dictionary expression. This addresses #7159. (#7970)

title: Method cannot be called, for a protocol type
Tuple size mismatch for `TypeVarTuple` and default arguments with TypeVars

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive when using a TypeVarTuple to capture the parameters of a generic callable that includes one or more default argument values. This addresses #7146. (#7150)

title: no error when accessing `__name__` on object with no `__name__` attribute

fix_commits.subject: Added special-case logic to handle `__name__` and a few other instanc… (#7148)
fix_commits.body:
* Added special-case logic to handle `__name__` and a few other instance variables defined in the `type` class so they are treated specially when accessed from a class instance. This addresses #7145.

* Fixed style issue.

title: Alias to enum member is treated as separate member

fix_commits.subject: Added support for enum member aliases defined within an enum class. This addresses #7142. (#7149)

title: Crash on functions accepting callbacks & positional arguments to them typed with `TypeVarTuple`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in an infinite loop when a function that uses an `*args: *Ts` parameter is passed as an argument to itself. This partially addresses #7141. (#7964)
Added test case for #7250, which was fixed by the same fix for #7141.

title: Chaining functions accepting callbacks & `*args` typed with `TypeVarTuple` fails to bind types

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in incorrect type evaluation when a function parameterized with a TypeVarTuple is passed as an argument to another function parameterized with a TypeVarTuple. This addresses #7140. (#7920)

title: Can't assign tuple containing a type + a TypeVarTuple to bare tuple

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug in tuple type compatibility logic that resulted in a false negative when dest type includes an upacked unbounded tuple plus additional entries. This addresses #7115. (#7152)
fix_commits.body:
Fixed bug in tuple type compatibility logic that resulted in a false positive when dest type is `tuple[Any, ...]`. This addresses #7129.
Improved error messages for tuple type mismatches that involve tuples with indeterminate types.

title: Type of `tuple[()]` should evaluate to `Sequence[Never]` rather than `Sequence[Unknown]`

fix_commits.subject: Changed the way pyright translates `tuple[()]` into a specialized `Sequence`. It used to translate it to `Sequence[Any]`, but the typing spec now clarifies that it should be `Sequence[Never]`. This addresses #7118. (#7119)

title: Incorrect type narrowing for tuples based on sequence pattern matching

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in incorrect type narrowing for sequence patterns when the subject expression contains a tuple with an unbounded component. This addresses #7117. (#7156)

title: Does not detect type incompatibility with tuple type

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug in tuple type compatibility logic that resulted in a false negative when dest type includes an upacked unbounded tuple plus additional entries. This addresses #7115. (#7152)
fix_commits.body:
Fixed bug in tuple type compatibility logic that resulted in a false positive when dest type is `tuple[Any, ...]`. This addresses #7129.
Improved error messages for tuple type mismatches that involve tuples with indeterminate types.

title: Tuple type form with multiple unpacks should be legal

fix_commits.subject: Changed handling of `tuple` with multiple unpacked embedded tuples. Type spec now clarifies this is OK as long as there are not multiple unbounded embedded tuples. This addresses #7114. (#7120)

title: UnionTypes are typed as `type[UnionType]`
TypeAliasType in runtime expression should evaluate to type `TypeAliasType` rather than `type[TypeAliasType]`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in incorrect type evaluation when a TypeAliasType is used in a value expression. This addresses #7109.

title: Use of methods on dynamically loaded instances of abstract base classes raise `reportAbstractUsage` errors

fix_commits.subject: Fixed regression that resulted in a false positive error when calling an abstract method on an abstract class that passes through the constraint solver (e.g. a generic decorator). This addresses #7105. (#7127)

title: `Final` should not be compatible with `type[T]`

fix_commits.subject: Added missing check for inappropriate use of `Final` in a value expression. This addresses #7094.

title: False positive when calling `tuple` constructor under influence of bidirectional type inference

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in incorrect type evaluation when calling a `tuple` constructor with bidirectional type inference and the value passed to the constructor is an `Iterable[Any]`. This addresses #7085. (#7155)

title: Special form `Any` should not be compatible with `type[T]`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false negative when the literal `typing.Any` is passed to a function that accepts a `type[T]`. `Any` is a special form and should not be compatible with `type`. This addresses #7082. (#7153)

title: Incorrect type narrowing in negative case for `isinstance` when filter type is generic

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug in `isinstance` type narrowing logic that leads to incorrect narrowed type when the filter type (the second argument) and the test type (the first argument) are both type variables. This addresses #7081. (#7194)

title: `tuple[Any, ...]` should be treated as a gradual type according to PEP 646

fix_commits.subject: Changed handling of `tuple[Any, ...]` so it is treated as though it's bidirectionally type compatible with all tuples regardless of length. This addresses #7053. (#7054)

title: In some cases, a useless temporary variable needs to be used with Annotated

fix_commits.subject: Improved handling of `Annotated` and other special forms when they are used in runtime value expressions rather than annotations. This addresses #7049. (#7050)

title: extraPaths in language server no longer work on pyright >= 1.1.340
False negative when passing invalid `lambda` to `Union` of higher-order functions

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that masked an error (false negative) under certain circumstances when evaluating a lambda. This addresses #7012. (#7059)

title: Type narrowing with metaclasses doesn't work in some situations

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug in the `isinstance` type narrowing logic when `type` is filtered using a metaclass instance. This addresses #7008. (#7015)

title: Pyright incorrectly computes whether a generator is async

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in an incorrect type evaluation when a generator uses an `await` operator within the left-most `for`. This shouldn't result in an `AsyncGenerator` despite what the Python documentation indicates. This addresses #6999. (#7013)

title: Argument type is unknown inside sum

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in a false positive error and incorrect type evaluation when an assignment expression (walrus operator) is used in a comprehension. This addresses #6992. (#7064)

title: No diagnostic rule for overridden final methods

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that caused "final method override" diagnostic to have no associated diagnostic rule. This addresses #6985.

title: LiteralString does not match str in pattern matching.

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug in class pattern matching logic that incorrectly narrows types when using a `str()` class pattern and a `LiteralString` subject. This addresses #6982. (#6983)

title: textDocument/codeAction fails without any further details.
false error: "NewType cannot be used with a class created with NewType"

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression whereby a type created with `NewType` was no longer allowed as an argument for another `NewType`. This addresses #6976. (#6978)

title: Spreading a tuple into an Annotation now produces an error

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression that results in a false positive error when an unpack operator is used in an `Annotated` type annotation. This addresses #6963.

title: Tuple size is lost while it can be deduced

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in an incorrect type evaluation for a sliced tuple if the end of the slice is the same as the tuple length (off-by-one error). This addresses #6958.

title: Unioned type variables are wrongly inferred

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in false positive error under certain circumstances that involve unions of TypeVars in an invariant context. This addresses #6957. (#7709)

title: AsyncGenerator with await incorrectly inferred (different from issue #1912)

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in incorrect inference of an async generator expression if an `await` keyword was used in a `for` iterator expression. This addresses #6948. (#6949)

title: When a protocol is defined in a stub, classes implementing that protocol are not checked for correctness

fix_commits.subject: Changed the way pyright identifies an "unimplemented protocol method" within a stub file. It now looks at whether the method is decorated with `@abstractmethod`. Previously, it assumed all such methods were potentially implemented. This addresses #6946. (#6947)

title: Generic exception tuple detected as not valid

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in a false positive error when using a bound TypeVar in an `except` statement. This addresses #6944. (#6945)

title: Data protocol is not rejected when used with `issubclass`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false negative when using a non-data protocol class in a tuple within an `issubclass` check. This addresses #6936.

title: Incorrect specialization of type alias when type arg list includes unpacked tuple

fix_commits.subject: Added support for generic type alias specialization when the type alias includes an unpacked TypeVarTuple and the specialization list includes an unpacked unbounded tuple. This addresses #6930. (#6974)

title: `TypeVar` constrained to `Literal[True]` and `Literal[False]` is resolved to `bool`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to incorrect type evaluation when a constrained TypeVar includes literal types as constraints. This addresses #6917. (#6929)

title: TypeVarTuple example from python docs yields error

fix_commits.subject: Improved evaluation logic for tuple slices. It now works in cases where the tuple includes unbounded entries or unpacked TypeVarTuples. This addresses #6906. (#6913)

title: False negative when specializing type alias that includes TypeVarTuple and TypeVar

fix_commits.subject: Added missing check for the specialization of a generic type alias that includes a TypeVarTuple plus two or more TypeVars. This addresses #6904.

title: False negative when specializing tuple type alias with incorrect type arguments

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in a false negative when specializing a generic type alias parameterized by a regular TypeVar with an unpacked tuple. This addresses #6903.

title: Incorrect evaluation of type alias that includes a TypeVarTuple and a TypeVar

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in an incorrect implied specialization of a generic type alias that is parameterized by a TypeVarTuple. The implied type argument should be `*tuple[Unknown, ...]` in this case. This addresses #6902. (#6980)

title: `TypeVarTuple` cannot have value constraints

fix_commits.subject: Fixed false negative for a `TypeVarTuple` constructor call that includes value constraints. This addresses #6901.

title: Incorrect type evaluation for variables that shadow type parameter names

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in incorrect type evaluation when a PEP-695 TypeVar is shadowed by an identifier of the same name within an inner scope. This addresses #6900. (#6911)

title: Incorrect type evaluation for `ParamSpec`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to an incorrect type evaluation for an explicitly-specialized class parameterized with a ParamSpec. This addresses #6899. (#6909)

title: `Concatenate` is not rejected when used in a simple type annotation

fix_commits.subject: Added code to report when the `Concatentate` special form is used in an illegal context. This addresses #6898. (#6910)

title: `Literal` should not be assignable to `type[T]`

fix_commits.subject: Improved handling of special forms defined in the typing module so they are treated correctly when used as runtime objects. (#6972)
fix_commits.body: Fixed false negative when a special form is assigned to a value declared as type[T] or when instantiated. This addresses #6895 and #6868.

title: Remove support for `Union[*Ts]`

fix_commits.subject: Removed support for `Union[*Ts]` and `Union[*tuple[...]]`. This functionality was included in an early draft of PEP 646 but was dropped in the final spec. The functionality can still be used in pyright if `useExperimentalFeatures` is set to true, but it will likely be removed entirely in the future. This addresses #6892. (#6912)

title: Slow performance on regular expression

fix_commits.subject: Improved type analysis performance in certain cases involving complex code flow graphs and "truthy" conditional statements. This addresses #6890. (#6922)

title: TypeVarTuple equality check for tuples

fix_commits.subject: Fixed spec conformance issue with TypeVarTuple constraint solving. The spec indicates that if a TypeVarTuple is used multiple times in a callee's signature, the tuple must "match exactly". This addresses #6888. (#7040)

title: PyRight language server crashes?
False positive error with variance validation in protocol

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in incorrect variance inference for protocols (and for PEP inferred-variance TypeVars in PEP 695) when a `self` or `cls` parameter is explicitly annotated with a type that includes the type parameter. This addresses #6883. (#6986)

title: No error reported when calling unimplemented protocol method in explicit subclass

fix_commits.subject: Added check for a call to an unimplemented method in a protocol from a base class that explicitly calls it. This addresses #6880. (#6925)

title: Protocol matching doesn't correctly handle class objects

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that led to incorrect protocol matching for class objects. This addresses #6879. (#6977)

title: NamedTuple functional form doesn't allow literal expressions to be used for field names

fix_commits.subject: Added support for constants for field names in `NamedTuple` call. This addresses #6878.

title: Generic attribute incompatible with generic property in protocol subclass

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that leads to a false positive when a generic property is defined within a protocol. This addresses #6877. (#6928)

title: Protocol matching doesn't reject explicit ClassVar in class when protocol is not marked as ClassVar

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug in protocol matching logic to reject a protocol match if a variable is a `ClassVar` in the protocol but not in the concrete class (or vice versa). This addresses #6869. (#6920)

title: `Callable` should not be a valid type for `type[T]`

fix_commits.subject: Improved handling of special forms defined in the typing module so they are treated correctly when used as runtime objects. (#6972)
fix_commits.body: Fixed false negative when a special form is assigned to a value declared as type[T] or when instantiated. This addresses #6895 and #6868.

title: False negative: In a stub file `@final` must be applied only to the first overload

fix_commits.subject: Added missing check for inconsistent use of `@final` in an overloaded function. Added missing check for override of an overloaded method marked `@final`. This addresses #6860 and #6866. (#6918)

title: Invalid type expression form (list literal) not rejected when used in Annotated

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that led to false negative when a list expression was used within the first type argument of an `Annotated` type expression. This addresses #6863.

title: Error should be reported if @final is applied to non-method function

fix_commits.subject: Added a missing error condition for a non-method function that is marked `@final`. This addresses #6861.

title: Overloaded method marked @final does not generate error when overridden

fix_commits.subject: Added missing check for inconsistent use of `@final` in an overloaded function. Added missing check for override of an overloaded method marked `@final`. This addresses #6860 and #6866. (#6918)

title: Type inference seems to ignore reachability analysis

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug in code flow analysis that resulted in an incorrect type evaluation when a "NoReturn" call is made within a code block protected by an exception-suppressing context manager. This addresses #6850. (#6859)

title: Pyright reports that class is missing __aenter__ when it isn’t

fix_commits.subject: Improved error reporting for `with` statement when `__enter__` or `__aenter__` is present but cannot be bound. This addresses #6849.

title: Pyright reports "not awaitable" even when a class has `def __await__`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false positive "not awaitable" error if the `__await__` method return type was Unknown. This addresses #6844.

title: TypeAliasType does not reject some illegal expression forms

fix_commits.subject: Improved logic that determines whether the expression used for a `type` statement or a call to `TypeAliasType` is a valid type expression. This addresses #6836 and #6831. (#6838)

title: Type alias created with `TypeAliasType` should generate error if referenced TypeVar is out of scope

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false negative when the `TypeAliasType` constructor is called with an expression that refers to a traditional TypeVar. This addresses #6835.

title: Type alias created with `TypeAliasType` doesn't allow access to `__value__`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in a false negative when attempting to access valid attributes from a type alias created via a call to the `TypeAliasType` constructor. This addresses #6834. (#6839)

title: False negative for protocol type compatibility with method that uses positional-only parameters

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that leads to a false negative when validating type compatibility between two callables and the source has a position-only parameter corresponding to a non-position-only parameter in the dest. This addresses #6833. (#6854)

title: `__post_init__` method in dataclass should be exempt from LSP
Type alias created with `type` statement doesn't reject invalid binary statement

fix_commits.subject: Improved logic that determines whether the expression used for a `type` statement or a call to `TypeAliasType` is a valid type expression. This addresses #6836 and #6831. (#6838)

title: `NewType` type restrictions are not enforced by pyright

fix_commits.subject: Added additional checks for invalid `NewType` calls. This addresses #6830, #6829 and #6828. (#6841)

title: Illegal expression forms for implicit type aliases are not rejected

fix_commits.subject: Improved detection of invalid type alias expressions for implicit (traditional) type aliases. This addresses #6827. (#6842)

title: TypeAlias with ParamSpec isn't specialized correctly

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to an incorrect type evaluation when explicitly specializing a generic class or type alias with a ParamSpec. This addresses #6826. (#6847)

title: Overlapping overload not reported when parameter type includes overlapping unions

fix_commits.subject: Improved overload overlap logic to detect partial overlaps when parameter types include unions that intersect. This addresses #6825. (#6856)

title: Illegal use of `Self` in metaclass is not rejected by pyright

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that leads to a false negative when `Self` is used within a class definition statement. PEP 637 explicitly rejects this usage of `Self`. This addresses #6805. (#6808)
fix_commits.body: Fixed a bug that leads to a false negative when `Self` is used within a metaclass. PEP 637 explicitly rejects this usage of `Self`. This addresses #6806.

title: Pyright accepts illegal use of `Self` in class declaration

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that leads to a false negative when `Self` is used within a class definition statement. PEP 637 explicitly rejects this usage of `Self`. This addresses #6805. (#6808)
fix_commits.body: Fixed a bug that leads to a false negative when `Self` is used within a metaclass. PEP 637 explicitly rejects this usage of `Self`. This addresses #6806.

title: Some illegal annotation expression forms are not flagged as errors

fix_commits.subject: Add error checking for illegal use of unary, binary, or ternary operators within a type annotation. This addresses #6800. (#6804)

title: Paramspec used within union reports errors that paramspec is missing

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug in the function type assignment logic that leads to a false positive under certain circumstances involving a ParamSpec in an overload with a callback that includes a positional-only parameter separator. This addresses #6796. (#6797)

title: Pyright crashes in VSCode when opening a git diff view
Stack overflow in `typeEvaluator`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that leads to infinite recursion (stack overflow). This addresses #6783.

title: Increase `maxSignatureContextCount` limit (and/or make it configurable) for ParamSpec

fix_commits.subject: Increased internal limit of the number of overload signatures that can be captured by a ParamSpec from 64 to 1024. This addresses #6781. (#6784)

title: Pyright  1.1.340 and 1.1.341 is either very slow or stuck forever

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a combinatoric explosion and an infinite loop in certain edge cases involving a class with an untyped constructor and methods that return recursive types. This addresses #6770. (#6775)

title: False positive of incompatible types (about generic protocol) since 1.1.337

fix_commits.subject: Fixed regression that results in incorrect type evaluation for annotations that involve nested protocols (such as `P[P[T]]`). This addresses #6767. (#7963)

title: False positive of "reportUnnecessaryComparison" with condition inside loop

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in incorrect type evaluation of a variable within a loop under certain conditions. This addresses #6764. (#6793)

title: Spurious error for partial unknown
Now getting `reportGeneralTypeIssues` when combining `divmod` with `typing.Self`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to false negative errors when doing protocol matching with a method that uses `Self` in its signature. This addresses #6760. (#6778)

title: 1.1.341: False positive involving ParamSpec

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive error under certain circumstances when calling an inner function that uses a ParamSpec defined scoped to an outer function. This addresses #6759. (#6762)

title: verifytypes: Missing docstring not reported for classes and methods from publicly exported classes in private modules

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug in the type verifier that resulted in a false negative when docstrings are missing from a class or function that is defined in a private module but re-exported from a public module. This addresses #6758. (#6771)

title: `reportDeprecated` broken in 1.1.341
pyright@1.1.340 It doesn't work
CLI with -w raises TypeError on file change
@contextmanager disables ParamSpec

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in a false positive error when one ParamSpec was captured by another ParamSpec. This addresses #6741.

title: 1.1.340: schema for --outputjson is not according to spec

fix_commits.subject: Fixed regression that caused JSON output to not follow the documented schema. This addresses #6740.

title: Error: Debug Failure. EmptyUri.getFilePath() should not be called
`pyright-langserver>=1.1.335` LSP does not annotate parameters for completion

fix_commits.subject: Improved signature help provider so it handles overloaded `__init__` and `__new__` methods when calling a constructor. This addresses #6734.

title: Pyright 1.1.340 doesn't include the scheme in the URI for the rename LSP action
Interaction between TypeVarTuple and TypeVar leads to Unknown

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug related to function type compatibility when the dest type contains an unpacked tuple followed by one or more positional-only parameters as in `Callable[[*Ts, int], None]`. This addresses #6724. (#6751)

title: nan is not a known member - pyright 1.1.340 with numpy stubs
Pyright v1.1.340 crashes with an internal error
Some settings have wrong defaults in the schema

fix_commits.subject: Fixed package manifest so default values of configurations are properly reflected. This addresses #6711.

title: non-returning Generator should infer `Never` for 3rd type parameter

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that led to incorrect return type inference for a generator that always raises an exception rather than returning. This addresses #6707. (#6708)

title: False positive with `unbound variable` under specific conditions

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to an improper "unbound" type evaluation under certain circumstances in a `finally` clause. This addresses #6704. (#6705)

title: `__qualname__` mistakenly believed to be defined as a global

fix_commits.subject: Removed implicit `__qualname__` attribute from the module namespace. It doesn't exist at runtime, so this was leading to a false negative. This addresses #6699. (#6701)

title: dict(zip(keys, values)) not correctly inferred when values is a tuple of operators

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false positive error in certain cases involving a union of two callables. This addresses #6695. (#6698)

title: Mark overloads of a function as being deprecated if `warnings.deprecated` is set on the function definition

fix_commits.subject: Added support for the `@warning.deprecated` (PEP 702) functionality when an overloaded function implementation is marked deprecated and then used outside of a call expression. This addresses #6689.

title: undetected `possibly unbound variable` in a list comprehension

fix_commits.subject: Extended support for "partially unbound" variable detection to cases that involve comprehension and class scopes. This addresses #6685. (#6693)
Issue6654 (#6697)
fix_commits.body:
* Extended support for "partially unbound" variable detection to cases that involve comprehension and class scopes. This addresses #6685.

* Fixed bug that led to a false positive when a tuple of indeterminate length was used in a callback function. This addresses #6654.

title: 'Zero-argument form of "super" call is valid only within a method' false positive when creating method in method
Non-deterministic type error

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that disabled return type inference for all functions when `analyzeUnannotatedFunctions` was set to false regardless of whether the function had input type annotations. This addresses #6679.

title: Crash when running language server
"x.y" is incompatible with "package.x.y" if letter case of argument does not match filesystem
Unexpected "Pattern will never be matched" warning/error after tuple case

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug in narrowing logic for sequence pattern magic where special cases of `str`, `bytes`, and `bytearray` were not handled correctly. This addresses #6670. (#6671)
