title: References are duplicated in neovim/helix

fix_commits.subject: Added code to deduplicate references returned by the textDocument/references LSP call. This addresses #7171.

title: Unnecessary extra escaped quotation at the of overrideParamNamePositionOnly diagnostic
imported self-referencing generic type aliases unhandled

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in a crash under certain circumstances when defining a type alias using a `type` statement when no type parameters are defined. This addresses #6664.

title: Multi-inheritance `super(SuperA, obj)` doesn't propery return the next `mro()` super

fix_commits.subject: Changed behavior of two-argument form of `super` when it is used outside of an attribute access expression. It now employs a heuristic whereby it evaluates to the next base class of the bound type. This addresses #6660. (#6662)

title: Regression in 1.1.338 with unnecessary isinstance check
overload declaration for arbitrary-length tuple parameter

fix_commits.subject: Issue6654 (#6697)
fix_commits.body:
* Extended support for "partially unbound" variable detection to cases that involve comprehension and class scopes. This addresses #6685.

* Fixed bug that led to a false positive when a tuple of indeterminate length was used in a callback function. This addresses #6654.

title: Incorrect narrowing for class pattern when `Callable` is used

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that led to improper type narrowing for class patterns when `Callable` is used. This addresses #6648. (#6650)

title: reportUnusedImport incorrectly reported

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in incorrect narrowed type evaluation in certain circumstances involving certain code flow graph structures. This addresses #6645. (#6653)
Added test case for #6645.

title: __delete__ in descriptor

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in incorrect type evaluation when `del` statement is applied to a class member implemented with a descriptor. This addresses #6636. (#6637)

title: reportUnknownMemberType not logged when inside dict.update

fix_commits.subject: Fixed regression that resulted in a false negative for the `reportUnknownMemberType` check when the expression is a call argument and the member is a function with a partially-unknown signature. This addresses #6634.

title: Crash in logic that checks return type

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in a crash within the function return type checking logic. This addresses #6632.

title: Edge case with operator lookup on Unions

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that led to incorrect type evaluation with unary operator when used with a type alias defined with forward references. This addresses #6629. (#6631)

title: variable has incorrect type after being narrowed inside context manager that suppresses an exception

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in incorrect type evaluation when a `raise` statement is used within a context manager that swallows exceptions. This addresses #6620. (#6621)

title: Use of PEP 695 `type` statement within a function body is not flagged as an error

fix_commits.subject: Added an error check for a PEP 695 `type` statement within a function body. Type alias definitions are not allowed within this scope. This addresses #6610.

title: 1.1.338: False positive passing `type` in for `Callable[..., Any]`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression that results in false positive error where `type` or `type[Any]` is not considered type compatible with `Callable`. This addresses #6600. (#6606)

title: False positive when using AsyncIterator

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive when `anext` is passed a value of type `AsyncIterator`. This addresses #6598. (#6601)

title: False negative with `type` annotation in dataclass in 1.1.338

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression that resulted in a false negative when `type` or `type[Any]` was used as a type annotation for a field in a dataclass. This addresses #6596. (#6597)

title: Derived TypedDict should allow field type override if field type is `Any`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in a false positive error when overriding a TypedDict field when the overridden type was `Any` or vice versa. This addresses #6590. (#6593)
fix_commits.body: Fixed bug that resulted in a false negative when overriding a TypedDict field with an incompatible `Required` or `NotRequired` attribute. This addresses #6588.

title: `typing.Self` is not usable as a value

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in a false positive when `Self` was used in a value expression outside of a class body. This addresses #6587.

title: Explicit ABCs inheriting from Protocols should not require all abstract methods to be implemented/redeclared.

fix_commits.subject: Changed behavior of check for unimplemented methods in a class that explicitly derives from a protocol. If the class also explicitly derives from `abc.ABC`, it is exempted from this check. This is useful for mixin classes. This addresses #6586.

title: Cannot reference built-in abstract base classes without type parameters

fix_commits.subject: Changed behavior of `reportUnknownMemberType` (and other checks in the `reportUnknown...` family) to not report a partially-unknown type if it refers to an unspecialized class. This addresses #6582. (#6608)

title: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'computedVariance')
Cannot assign argument to `Protocol`-`TypeVar`, despite said argument being assignable to the `Protocol`.

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in incorrect type evaluation in certain cases involving generic protocols and bound TypeVars. This addresses #6579. (#6641)

title: Errors using method decorator with generic class

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in a false positive error under certain circumstances involving inferred variance, decorators and generic type aliases. This addresses #6574. (#6578)

title: `Commands.addMissingOptionalToParam` can't be set in type evaluator
False negative when `Self` is used with a callback type

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that produces a false negative when attempting to assign a method to a `Callable` type where the first parameter of the method is typed as `Self`, but the callback requires the class itself. This addresses #6568. (#6569)

title: Numpy: errors inputting numeric type aliases to `np.iinfo` and `np.finfo`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed regression that results in incorrect handling of `type[T]` in a type alias. This was a long-standing bug that was exposed by a recent change. It addresses #6559. (#6561)

title: `Never` should not be allowed as a type argument for a type parameter with constraints

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that led to a false negative when `Never` is used as an explicit type argument for a generic class or type alias if the corresponding type parameter is a constrained TypeVar. This addresses #6557. (#6562)

title: Cannot access class properties on instances

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression that resulted in a false positive when accessing a class property from a class instance. This addresses #6555.

title: `type[Any]` should allow access to any member that is not defined on `type` or `object` class

fix_commits.subject: Changed type evaluation logic for member access expressions for `type[Any]` where the target attribute is not explicitly declared in the `type` or `object` class. Previously, pyright emitted an error in this case. This addresses #6552. (#6553)

title: Improper type narrowing for pattern matching with literals
Passing an enum type as a ``converter`` argument causes type check error

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that led to incorrect conversion from a class constructor to a function when it involves a `__new__` method that returns `Self`. This addresses #6529. (#6541)

title: Inconsistent Behavior in Type Checking for `collections.abc.Callable` and `collections.abc`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a false positive error in the `reportUnknownMemberType` check when `abc.Callable` (without any type arguments) is used in the second argument to an `isinstance` call. This addresses #6527.

title: More numpy-specific general type issues (_ArrayLikeFloat_co, _NestedSequence)

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that can result in spurious false positive errors when using deeply-nested or recursive type definitions such as `_NestedSequence` in numpy. This addresses #6523. (#6556)

title: False negative with dict literal on strict mode

fix_commits.subject: Changed the behavior for empty dict or list expressions. Previously, a variable initialized with `{}` or `[]` was not flagged as "partially unknown" by the `reportUnknownArgument` check when used as an argument to a call. This resulted in a small type hole. This addresses #6514. (#6547)

title: Pylance will ignore anything marked as Never

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in incorrect type evaluation of an index expression when the LHS is unbound. It should produce `Unknown` rather than `Never`. This addresses #6512. (#6518)

title: Two identical functions behave differently in different files (and depending on their order)

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in a false positive under certain circumstances where a recursive type alias was used and hit an internal recursion limit. This addresses #6511. (#6520)

title: `Self` type infer error when using overrided `__getitem__`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that led to a false positive error when a `__getitem__` returns `Self`. This addresses #6500. (#6502)

title: Types are not narrowed by multi-pattern `case`

fix_commits.subject: Issue6492 (#6493)
fix_commits.body:
* Fixed a bug that resulted in a false positive error when a higher-order generic function is passed another generic function as an argument along with another argument that dictates the type of the first argument's type variable(s). This shouldn't depend on the order in which the arguments are passed. This addresses #6461.

* Added support for discriminated TypedDict pattern matching when union patterns are used. This addresses #6492.

title: Regression in type narrowing for type variable with union bound

fix_commits.subject: Modified recent bug fix in `isinstance` and `issubclass` type narrowing logic so it better handles type variables with bounds that are unions. This addresses #6475. (#6485)

title: Assigning param value via walrus operator `:=` in function with `@overload` signature results in `reportGeneralTypeIssues` error

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in a false positive error when using a walrus operator in a call expression that targets an overloaded function. This addresses #6470. (#6471)

title: Regression: Type cheking of binary operations involving numpy scaler types fails with 1.1.336

fix_commits.subject: Fixed regression that resulted in false positive errors when a magic method (e.g. `__lt__` or `__add__`) are implemented with a callable protocol object. This addresses #6466. (#6469)

title: Something in hover provider broke in a commit released in 1.1.333
isinstance with type[Protocol] doesn't work now.

fix_commits.subject: Fixed regression that results in a false positive when using a value of type `type[Protocol]` as the second argument to `isinstance` or `issubclass` if the protocol isn't `@runtime_checkable`. This addresses #6463. (#6464)

title: Unable to match Protocol implementation with function-level generic to Protocol interface using class-level generic depending on order of function arguments.

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in a false positive error when a higher-order generic function is passed another generic function as an argument along with another argument that dictates the type of the first argument's type variable(s). This shouldn't depend on the order in which the arguments are passed. This addresses #6461. (#6491)
Issue6492 (#6493)
fix_commits.body:
* Fixed a bug that resulted in a false positive error when a higher-order generic function is passed another generic function as an argument along with another argument that dictates the type of the first argument's type variable(s). This shouldn't depend on the order in which the arguments are passed. This addresses #6461.

* Added support for discriminated TypedDict pattern matching when union patterns are used. This addresses #6492.

title: Passing concatenated tuple to positional rest arg results in unknown argument type error

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that led to a spurious "unknown argument type" when passing an unpacked tuple in a call expression. This addresses #6458. (#6459)

title: Failed to call method "__get__" for descriptor class "property"

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a recent regression that resulted in a false positive error when a parent class defines a property with a getter and a child class extends the property with a setter. This addresses #6456. (#6495)

title: Type of destructured arguments are unknown with `chain.from_iterable()`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that led to an incorrect type evaluation when a list comprehension expression is used with bidirectional type inference and the expected type includes a type variable. This addresses #6455. (#6496)

Added code to propagate information about certain typing module imports from an implicitly-imported module (e.g. `builtins` or `__builtins__.pyi`) so `Final` and `ClassVar` can be treated as special forms by the binder. This fixes the use of these typing symbols in notebooks within pylance, which leverages implicitly-imported modules to "chain together" notebook cells. This addresses #6455.

title: Failed to call method "__get__" for descriptor class

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in a false positive when applying a descriptor whose `__get__` method whose `owner` parameter is annotated with `type[T]`. This addresses #6452. (#6453)

title: Unable to discriminate between self-referential types when using unions

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that affected the `isinstance` type narrowing logic when the pre-narrowed type is a type alias that refers to a union that includes a recursive type alias. This addresses #6451.

title: Conditional variables with generic not getting narrowed

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to incorrect type evaluation when an inferred method return type includes a union where the subtypes are conditioned on constraints of a constrained TypeVar that parameterizes the class. In this case, one or more of these subtypes should be eliminated when a specialized class is bound to the method. This addresses #6446. (#6449)

title: pyright gives exit code 0 on invalid file

fix_commits.subject: Added code to CLI to verify file specs passed on the command line. If they don't exist, emit an error and a non-zero exit code. This addresses #6443.

title: Unexpected incompatibility of inline dict with container of `TypedDict`s, with `reportUnnecessaryContains` enabled

fix_commits.subject: Added special-case handling `x in y` narrowing logic for the case where `x` is a `dict` or `Mapping` and `y` is an iterable of `TypedDict`s. This addresses #6436. (#6438)

title: Narrowing to a protocol loses information about self type

fix_commits.subject: Modified the `isinstance` type narrowing logic to retain a TypeVar when narrowing in the positive case and the value is not a constrained TypeVar. This addresses #6434. (#6439)

title: False-positive `reportPrivateUsage` for `matplotlib.colormaps`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that leads to a false positive `reportPrivateUsage` diagnostic when importing a public symbol from a "py.typed" library if that symbol is imported from a private symbol (and re-exported publicly) within the library. This addresses #6429.

title: `Self` is not working correctly with a custom descriptor which captures self type
Class without `__init__` and `__new__` is  `(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Class`

fix_commits.subject: Changed behavior when converting a class to a callable. If the class has no `__init__` or `__new__` method in its class hierarchy (other than those provided by `object`), pyright previously converted the constructor to a signature of `(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any)`. It now converts it to a signature of `()` (i.e. no params) unless it's a `type[T]` or a protocol class. This addresses #6426. (#6427)

title: Doing a star import that contains TypeVar in its scope changes its type to Unknown

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in incorrect type evaluation of a symbol imported twice by two redundant wildcard imports. This addresses #6420.

title: Pyright doesn't report type error when passing incorrect generic collection type after narrowing in for-loop

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug in the code flow engine that resulted in a false negative for a variable whose type is narrowed within an inner loop. This addresses #6417. (#6642)

title: Unexpected incompatibility of identical `TypedDict`s

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false positive when determining the type compatibility of two TypedDict definitions whose keys were typed with unions that included two other (compatible) TypedDict definitions. This addresses #6416. (#6506)

title: No overloads for "__getitem__" match the provided arguments (regression in 1.1.335)
Import resolver prefers typeshed stub over local module with same name
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'nodeType')
Problem with self in magic methods like `__add__`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that leads an incorrect type evaluation when binding a magic method (like `__add__`) to `self` when the magic method returns `Self`. This addresses #6388. (#6418)

title: Type error with getitem of StrEnum failed with 1.1335

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in false positive when indexing an enum class. This addresses #6387. (#6390)

title: Second use of PEP 695 generic function causes type error

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false positive error when calling the same generic function multiple times in a call expression. This bug specifically affected the case where the generic function used PEP 695 syntax. This addresses #6386.

title: Little issue with type inference for sorted built-in function
`TypeError` when checking with 1.1.335

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in a crash during type analysis. This addresses #6383.

title: Does not report Incompatible Method Override when override overload

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false negative when a subclass overrides a parent class with an overloaded method in an incompatible manner. This addresses #6382. (#6396)

title: `Self` is incompatible with instance constructed from partial of `cls` parameter

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in an incorrect type evaluation when `functools.partial` is used with a constructor where `type[Self]` is passed as the first argument. This addresses #6378. (#6379)

title: `x is None` type guard incorrectly narrows `Self` in the negative case

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to incorrect type narrowing for the `x is None` in the negative (else) case when `x` is a bound TypeVar (or `Self`). This addresses #6361. (#6365)

title: Missing space in reveal_type() output for "not"

fix_commits.subject: Fix missing space after "not" in reveal_type() output (#6346)

title: Unexpected error when wrapping `self` with `ref`

fix_commits.subject: Issue6335 (#6357)
fix_commits.body:
* Fixed bug in completion provider that resulted in an attempt to tokenize and parse a binary (native) library file. This led to a crash in some cases. This addresses https://github.com/microsoft/pylance-release/issues/5090.

* Fixed a bug that results in a false positive error when a `__new__` method returns `Self` for a generic class and the type variable is invariant. This addresses #6335.

title: reportIncompatibleMethodOverride can give a ambiguous overrideParamNamePositionOnly diagnostic

fix_commits.subject: Improved diagnostic message for method overrides based on keyword/position-only parameter mismatch. This addresses #6333.

title: False positive `reportUnnecessaryContains` error when `self` is used

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that causes a false positive `reportUnnecessaryContains` error when `self` is used on the LHS of the `in` operator within an enum class. This addresses #6329. (#6330)

title: Failure to guess when a generic function is used as an argument

fix_commits.subject: Improved lambda inference logic to handle the case where the expected type is a callable that accepts a generic callable as a parameter. This addresses #6326. (#6498)

title: Pyright doesn't resolve descriptors when the base class is Any

fix_commits.subject: Restored previous behavior (prior to 1.1.334) where an instance of a class that derives from `Any` will not be considered type compatible with `None`. This addresses #6325. (#6348)

title: Missing error for PEP 692 when keyword names overlap

fix_commits.subject: Added missing check described in PEP 692 where fields within an unpacked TypedDict used for `**kwargs` cannot overlap other keyword parameters in the same signature. This addresses #6321.

title: Incorrect reportIncompatibleMethodOverride when subclass overrides overloaded method if last overload does not match the type of the subclass and is omitted from subclass.

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a false positive `reportIncompatibleMethodOverride` error under certain circumstances where an overloaded method overrides another overloaded method. This addresses #6320.

title: Signature help reports incorrect signature when using PEP 692

fix_commits.subject: Fixed several bugs in the signature help provider when handling `**kwargs` parameters typed with an unpacked TypeDict (PEP 692). This addresses #6319.

title: Generic TypedDict fails with Generic base

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that causes a false positive MRO error when creating a subclass of a generic TypedDict and another TypedDict. This addresses #6318.

title: Protocol and TypeAlias don't seem to support TypeVarTuple concatenation

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false positive error when specializing a type alias consisting of a callable parameterized by a TypeVarTuple. This partially addresses #6317.

Fixed a bug that results in incorrect type evaluation of a call expression when the callee is a function parameterized by a TypeVarTuple that has been specialized with a concatenation form. This addresses #6317.

title: Incorrect type deduction of nested/higher-level Callable with TypeVarTuple parameter

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in incorrect type evaluation when using a `TypeVarTuple` within a nested `Callable` type (i.e. a `Callable` that takes a `Callable` as a parameter). This addresses #6316. (#6322)

title: 1.1.333, 1.1.334 regression - high CPU usage (~100% single core) in VS Code
1.1.334 regression: `files` cli argument not respected?

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression in the CLI that caused the `--files` command-line parameters to be overridden by the "include" setting in the config file. This change restores the behavior prior to 1.1.334. This addresses #6311.

title: Cannot override method with lambda (introduced in 1.1.334)

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that led to a false positive when assigning a lambda with `*args` to a callable type that doesn't contain `*args`. This addresses #6308. (#6312)

title: narrowing type resolves to unexpected type

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a few places where union order resulted in different type evalu… (#6306)
fix_commits.body:
* Fixed a few places where union order resulted in different type evaluation behaviors. This addresses #6302.

* Fixed style issue.

title: False negative when using zero-argument form of `super` within a static method

fix_commits.subject: Added missing error check for zero-argument form of `super()` when used within a static method. This addresses #6298.

title: False positive when validating type compatibility between metaclass instance and type[T]

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in a false positive when validating type consistency between a metaclass instance and `type[T]`. This addresses #6285. (#6286)

title: Pyright gets stuck in analysis on specific file
Wrong type inferred when passing list concatenation expression to Iterable[T] argument

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to incorrect type evaluation when two lists with different types were concatenated using a `+` operator in a bidirectional inference context. This addresses #6273. (#6509)

title: generic variable narrowed to `Never` on `if (not) x` case

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug in the type guard logic for simple truthy/falsy checks. If the type is an instance of `object` or a `TypeVar` with no bound (which is treated like an `object`), the logic should not assume that it will always evaluate to truthy. This addresses #6266. (#6269)

title: Error message is misleading and unhelpful when descriptor access fails

fix_commits.subject: Improved error message for descriptor accesses where binding or type validation fails for the `__get__`, `__set__` or `__delete__` methods. This addresses #6263. (#6297)

title: "Class" is compatible with "Self@Class"

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in false positive reportIncompatibleMethodOverload error under certain circumstances. This is part of the solution for #6261.
Changed the way properties are modeled internally to the type checker. This change is required as part of the fix for #6261. (#6327)
Fixed bug that led to a false negative when assigning type `Class` to `Self@Class`. This should not be permitted, but it was. This addresses #6261. (#6331)
Added test cases for #6261 and fixed a bug found by test. (#6332)

title: `type` and `Type` are narrowed inconsistently when using `isinstance`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that led to an inconsistency between the use of `type` and … (#6253)
fix_commits.body:
* Fixed bug that led to an inconsistency between the use of `type` and `Type` when applying `isinstance` type narrowing in some cases. This addresses #6252.

* Fixed a bug that led to a false positive when using an unpacked iterable as an argument in a call expression _after_ a keyword argument. This addresses #6247.

fix_commits.subject: Eliminated some differences between the treatment of `type` and `Type`. These should be treated the same under all circumstances. This addresses #6252. (#6551)

title: Pyright mishandles call with varargs following keyword arg

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false positive when using an unpacked iterable as an argument in a call expression _after_ a keyword argument. This addresses #6247.
Fixed bug that led to an inconsistency between the use of `type` and … (#6253)
fix_commits.body:
* Fixed bug that led to an inconsistency between the use of `type` and `Type` when applying `isinstance` type narrowing in some cases. This addresses #6252.

* Fixed a bug that led to a false positive when using an unpacked iterable as an argument in a call expression _after_ a keyword argument. This addresses #6247.

title: `typing_extensions.TypeVar` instance becomes `typing.TypeVar`

fix_commits.subject: Improved support for runtime `TypeVar`, `TypeVarTuple` and `ParamSpec` objects, including when they are instantiated from `typing_extensions` classes. This addresses #6241. (#6245)

title: `Callable[[], NoReturn]` does not act like `NoReturn` when called in match statement

fix_commits.subject: Fixed issue that led to false positive error when calling a `NoReturn` function within a `case` block or within an `if`/`elif` chain. This addresses #6234. (#6238)

title: Infinite loop in `_getModuleNameForImport`
[VSCode][Protocols] Inconsistent errors when using protocols with immutable data containers

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug in protocol matching when source is a namedtuple or a frozen dataclass. Algorithm wasn't taking into account that attributes in these classes are immutable. This addresses #6226. (#6228)

title: Typechecking lightgbm regression since 1.1.325

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a performance regression that affected symbol type inference in the presence of circular dependencies. This addresses #6224.

title: Incorrect type checking of protocol with independent TypeVars

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false positive error when doing protocol matching for a protocol and implementation that use a combination of class-scoped and function-scoped TypeVars. This addresses #6213. (#6215)

title: Tuple arg gets ignored when variable is assigned a value

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in incorrect narrowing on assignment when the assigned type is a tuple that includes one or more `Any` type arguments and the declared type is a tuple without an `Any`. This addresses #6208. (#6212)

title: False-positive errors for attrs - wrong types for `default` argument?

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in false positive when evaluating the call to a generic function that involves a type variable used in both a covariant and contravariant (or invariant) position and both literal and non-literal types are involved. This addresses part of #6207. (#8049)

title: `TypedDict` fields should be considered invariant
False positive error when `type(None)` or `NoneType` is used as second argument to `issubclass`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false positive error when passing `type(None)` or `NoneType` as the second argument to `issubclass`. This addresses part of #6186.
Fixed a bug in the `issubclass` type narrowing logic for `type(None)` and `NoneType` filters. This addresses #6186.

title: False positive error when instantiating `type[Self]` in abstract class

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false positive error when attempting to instantiate a value of type `type[Self]` when `Self` refers to an abstract class. This addresses #6184. (#6185)

title: Pyright failing to match recursive (nested?) generic protocol

fix_commits.subject: Improved error message for protocol mismatch when a method in the source cannot be bound. This partially addresses #6183. (#6202)
Improved error message for protocol mismatch when a method in the source cannot be bound. This partially addresses #6183. (#6204)
Fixed a bug that led to a false positive when doing protocol matching for a protocol that uses deeply nested recursion. This addresses #6183. (#6205)

title: Error telemetry: Max call stack size exceeded.

fix_commits.subject: Added an assert with some logging to better diagnose a condition that is causing a stack overflow due to ParamSpec recursion. This is related to #6178. (#6179)
Fixed a bug that led to a stack overflow crash under certain circumstances when evaluating a function call with a ParamSpec. This partially addresses #6178. (#6188)
Fixed bug that led to false negative when evaluating a call to a function with a recursive ParamSpec. This addresses the remainder of #6178. (#6262)

title: Narrowing for zero-length sequence pattern evaluates incorrect type

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug in the type narrowing logic for sequence patterns, specifically when the subject is `Any` or `Unknown` and the sequence pattern is empty (`[]`). This addresses #6177.

title: confusing diagnostics: `cls = type(x:alias)` reported as `cls:alias`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug in "type printer", the code that converts a type to text for error messages. It wasn't properly handling `type(t)` where `t` is defined using a type alias. This addresses #6173. (#6175)

title: False positive "TypeVar bound cannot be generic" error

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a false positive error "TypeVar bound cannot be generic" if the bound type is a generic class whose type parameters have default types (using PEP 696). This addresses #6171. (#6172)

title: False negative "Type alias "Point" cannot be used in this context"

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false positive error when a type alias created using PEP 695 syntax is used as a type argument for a generic type when used in the LHS of a call expression. This addresses #6169.

title: 1.1.329-1.1.331: More regressions in composite expressions involving overloads

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a regression in overload matching that resulted in false positive errors in hydra-zen. This change involves removing a heuristic from overload matching that attempted to eliminate a false positive error for `x: list[str] = "a,b".split(",")`. This addresses #6160. (#6163)

title: `reportImplicitOverride` not triggered in type stubs

fix_commits.subject: Changed override-related checks (`reportIncompatibleMethodOverride`, `reportIncompatibleVariableOverride` and `reportImplicitOverride`) so they apply to stub files. Previously, these were skipped for stubs. This addresses #6158. (#6159)

title: narrowing to `Never` from instance of metaclass

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug in the `issubclass` type narrowing logic when the first argument is a metaclass (a subclass of `type`). This addresses #6152. (#6154)

title: Renaming a symbol in a module in a symlink directory not taken into account
Use of `Any` as a value expression should be flagged as error

fix_commits.subject: Added logic to detect illegal use of the symbol `Any`. This addresses #6144. (#6151)

title: Type inference of generic function required a variable

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug in ParamSpec type matching that resulted in an incorrect type evaluation under certain circumstances. This addresses #6141. (#6162)

title: When passing generic class (not instance) to decorator expecting callable, generic type is inferred as 'Unknown' in return type of decorated function.
unittest.mock.Mock is not treated as Any in strict mode

fix_commits.subject: Changed type evaluation behavior for accesses to attributes on a class that derives from `Any`. Previously, these were evaluated as `Unknown`, but they are now evaluated as `Any`. This is related to #6136. (#6137)

title: Incorrect type narrowing in the type(x) is self.__class__ (regression in 1.1.331)
Protocol with callable attribute that has a recursive return type
Tuple member is incorrectly inferred as Unknown

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in an unresolved `Unknown` type within a tuple constructed within a loop. This addresses #6119. (#6130)

title: Regression in 1.1.331 for `__new__` and/or `Self`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed regression in `type(x) is y` type narrowing logic when `y` is of type `type[Self]`. This addresses #6118. (#6125)

title: Pylance complains "Literal[10]" is incompatible with "property" when using modules as implementations of protocol

fix_commits.subject: Fixed several bugs in protocol matching that led to false positives when matching a protocol against a module. This addresses #6117. (#6132)

title: Pyright crashes with RangeError

fix_commits.subject: Fixed crash that occurs when encountering a malformed system version check of the form `sys.version_info[0] < 3.8`. This addresses #6116.

title: Unexpected literal type narrowing within generator expression

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug in `x is <Literal>` and `x == <Literal>` type guard logic. It was not properly handling the case where `x` is `Any` or `Unknown`. This addresses #6109. (#6110)

title: Weird error message when setting class variable of the wrong type (not in an instance)

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a confusing error message when assigning a value with an incompatible type to a class variable that has no explicit type declaration. This addresses #6106. (#6107)

title: False negative when type arguments are used for `Callable` within `isinstance` call

fix_commits.subject: Added missing check for the use of a subscripted `Callable` within an `isinstance` call. This addresses #6101. (#6103)

title: `isinstance` type narrowing doesn't support `Callable`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that led to incorrect type narrowing for `isinstance` when using `Callable` and the pre-narrowed type is `object`. This addresses #6100. (#6104)

title: Use of an `@deprecated` property is not reported as an error

fix_commits.subject: Added support for @deprecated when applied to property accessors and descriptor methods. This addresses #6094.

title: 'Zero-argument form of "super" call is valid only within a method' false positive when creating subclass in method

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false positive error when using a zero-argument `super()` call within a class declaration within a method body. This addresses #6093.
Fixed bug that led to a false positive when a zero-argument form of `super` is called within an inner function or lambda. This addresses #6093. (#6682)

title: Since version 1.1.326 pyright allows to assign the wrong type to a field of an sqlalchemy ORM class

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a recent regression that led to a false positive error when a class uses a custom metaclass that supplies a `__setattr__` method. This addresses #6089. (#6090)

title: `functools.wraps` type inference broken when inferring return type of wrapper

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in incorrect type evaluation when an async function with an inferred return type is decorated with a class or function that uses a ParamSpec (such as `functools.wraps`). This addresses #6080. (#6081)

title: Invalid syntax error in multi-line f-string with format spec

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false positive error when using a single-quote form of a format string that uses a format specifier expression. This is also a bug in the Python 3.12 interpreter that is being fixed. This addresses #6077. (#6082)

title: Variable type is narrowed incorrectly when it is assigned later within a loop

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false positive error and incorrect type evaluation under certain circumstances when multiple symbols depend on each other in a loop. This addresses #6075. (#6085)

title: 1.1.329: Regression in composite expressions involving overloads
Incorrect type inference in list comprehension inside closure

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to the loss of type narrowing for a captured variable used within an inner scope if used in a comprehension expression. This addresses #6067. (#6073)

title: Strange report of "incompatible type" when Protocol with function-level generic is passed through wrapper class.

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false positive error when doing protocol matching with a protocol class that has a method with method-scoped type variables. This addresses #6064. (#6098)

title: False positive for reportInvalidStringEscapeSequence in very long string

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a false positive `reportInvalidStringEscapeSequence` error if a string literal is over 32K in length and the 32768'th character is a backslash. This addresses #6062.

title: Awaitablity checks not fully complete

fix_commits.subject: Improved the check for whether an object is "awaitable". Rather than hard-coding checks for `__await__` and `__init__` methods, use the `typing.Awaitable` protocol. This addresses #6053. (#6055)

title: dictionary literal cannot be inferred as TypedDict generic parameter

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to incorrect type evaluation and false positives when constructing a specialized generic TypedDict. This addresses #6052. (#6054)

title: pandas-stubs works with 1.1.326, not with 1.1.329

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a recent regression in the overload matching behavior that broke two tests in the pandas-stubs test suite. This addresses #6044. (#6046)

title: Incorrect type inference in combined enumerate, sorted, filter, with lambdas

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to incorrect type evaluation in a nested set of call expressions and a lambda. This addresses #6042. (#6105)

title: v1.1.329 incorrectly assuming type of a division is an `int`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a regression that resulted in a false positive error when using `float` or `complex` literals or constructor calls and then accessing a member of the resulting object that is valid on that class but not on `int`. This addresses #6032. (#6040)
Issue6032 (#6048)
fix_commits.body:
* Fixed a bug that resulted in a false positive in certain circumstances where a lambda included simple math operations with integer literals. The fix requires disabling literal math within lambdas, since they are often used as callbacks that are called repeatedly in a loop. This addresses #6031.

* Reverted a portion of the recent changes designed to differentiate between a `float` that is really a `float` or a `float` that can also be an `int`. This resulted in false positives when inferring types using float literals. This addresses #6032.

title: Odd lambda type inference for functools.reduce with initial values involving literal zeros

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in a false positive in certain circumstances where a lambda included simple math operations with integer literals. The fix requires disabling literal math within lambdas, since they are often used as callbacks that are called repeatedly in a loop. This addresses #6031. (#6047)

title: Are frozen dataclass members mutable?
Invalid type Inference when generic function passed as argument in another generic
`del list[i]` results in incorrect Unbound on subsequent access

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a false positive due to incorrect type narrowing logic when a `del` statement targets a specific element within a list (e.g. `del my_list[1]`). This addresses #6026. (#6050)

title: False positive in reportUnnecessaryComparison

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a false positive error with the `reportUnnecessaryComparison` check when a recursive type alias is used. This addresses #6017.

title: Improper override not reported

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug in the `reportIncompatibleMethodOverride` check that leads to a false negative if the base class uses a `Self` type and the override uses an incompatible specialized type. This addresses #6010. (#6138)

title: Incorrect error on specific order of multi-pattern `case` clause

fix_commits.subject: Improved handling of types `float` and `complex`, which are special-cased in PEP 484 as "promotion types". The new logic now properly models the runtime behavior for `isinstance` and class pattern matching when used with these promotion types. This addresses #6008. (#6013)

title: `LiteralString` type is not enforced in invariant context

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug in type compatibility checks for `LiteralString`. It should not be considered compatible with `str` or a specific literal str in an invariant context. This addresses #5999. (#6014)

title: Module cannot be assigned to generic procotol

fix_commits.subject: Fixed several issues with logic that performs protocol matching against a module, including a false positive error when matching against a generic protocol. This addresses #5997.

title: False positive of "reportIncompatibleVariableOverride" when subclassing a frozen dataclass

fix_commits.subject: Fixed false positive error that occurs when a member of a frozen dataclass is overridden in a subclass. In this case, the type should not be considered invariant because the field isn't mutable. This addresses #5993.

title: Unknown argument type when calling `.pop` with default on non-total TypedDict

fix_commits.subject: Updated the synthesized `pop` method for `TypedDict` so its signature is consistent with the synthesized `get` method. This eliminates an `Unknown` in some cases. This addresses #5981. (#5982)

title: Unknown variable reported with .format but not with f-string?

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that led to incorrect generation of `Unknown` type evaluation when an overloaded function is called in a loop and one of the arguments to the call depends on the return value. This addresses #5980. (#5983)

title: Unreachable yield should still make a function a generator

fix_commits.subject: Improved validation of generator return type. Previously, the check was performed only for `yield` statements, but it's possible to define a generator function that has no reachable yield statements. This addresses #5972. (#5975)

title: Pyright make false assumption about size of tuple

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that led to a false positive error when checking for out-of-bounds tuple accesses if the indexed type is a union that includes both a bounded tuple and an unbounded tuple. This addresses #5968. (#5977)

title: `deprecated` decorator with multi line reason string doesn't work on implementation when function has overloads

fix_commits.subject: Fixed inconsistent behavior of `@deprecated` between overloaded and non-overloaded functions. This addresses #5966.

title: Pylance thinks an `object` will never match a dictionary pattern in `match`
`deprecated` decorator doesn't work on context managers

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that caused `@deprecated` message not to be passed through a ParamSpec. This addresses #5949.

title: `deprecated` decorator doesn't work when calling deprecated overload as a decorator

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that caused a `typing.deprecated` decorator not to be marked as such. This addresses #5948.

title: Regression: Type Inference fails again on nested zip calls

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a regression that caused an `Unknown` to appear in a type evaluation when using nested constructor calls. This addresses #5947. (#5984)

title: Discrepancy between narrowed type and revealed type

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug in the `isinstance` type narrowing logic when using a generic class whose type parameters include defaults (PEP 696). This addresses #5944. (#6170)

title: Import resolution not respecting virtual environments
No error when non-TypedDict base precedes TypedDict

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false negative when using a non-TypedDict base class within a TypedDict class statement. This addresses #5937.

title: False positive with inline TypedDict and postponed annotations

fix_commits.subject: Fixed false positive error when using a forward-declared reference inside of an inlined TypedDict when `from __future__ import annotations` is in effect. This addresses #5935.

title: Regression: ctypes.Structure reports error when classmethod is called

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in incorrect type evaluation when accessing an attribute on a class whose metaclass defines a `__getattr__` method and the target attribute is a descriptor object. This addresses #5932.

title: dataclass reported as unhashable when __eq__ is overridden

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false positive error when a frozen dataclass has an explicit `__eq__` method and is used in way that requires it to be `Hashable`. This addresses #5928.

title: Method TypeVar without default should be allowed to follow class TypeVar with default

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a false positive error when a TypeVar with a default value (as specified in PEP 696) appears within a method after an outer-scoped TypeVar without a default value. This addresses #5925.

title: Spurious error generated when inner function contains `P.args` annotation and decorator

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in a spurious error under certain circumstances when evaluating the type of a parameter within a nested function whose type refers to an outer-scope type variable. This addresses #5913. (#5918)

title: Operator "==" is (incorrectly) not supported on something with type of union of a `TypeVarTuple`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in false positive error when using a `Union[*Ts]` value in a binary expression. This addresses #5910.

title: Strange/inconsistent error messages when accessing missing members of relatively-imported modules within class functions

fix_commits.subject: Improved error messages that include module names. Previously, there were inconsistencies in how module names were reported. This addresses #5907. (#5930)

title: ParamSpec defaults don't work with Literal["..."]

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false positive error when enclosing `...` in quotes when specifying a ParamSpec default value. This addresses #5904.

title: Incorrect type narrowing between deriving protocols

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug in the `isinstance` type narrowing logic that evaluated the incorrect type when two protocol classes are involved. This addresses #5901.

title: Callable and Concatenate treat non-constraining ParamSpec and literal ellipses differently

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in a false positive error when `*args` and `**kwargs` are passed as arguments to a function with a `ParamSpec` and the types of `*args` and `**kwargs` is `Any`. This addresses #5899. (#5957)

title: `deprecated` decorator doesn't work on implementation when function has overloads
deprecations not correctly marked for coroutine functions
Literal dict typed with union drops all union members except the first

fix_commits.subject: Improved determinism of bidirectional type inference for dictionary, list, set and tuple expressions when the expected type is a union of types that includes more than one plausible candidate. The types in the union are now sorted so type evaluation doesn't depend on the order in which the union was defined. This addresses part of #5887. (#5888)

Fixed a bug that led to the incorrect type evaluation of a constructor call when bidirectional type inference is used and the expected type is a union that includes more than one compatible instance type. This addresses #5887. (#5890)

title: `isinstance` type narrowing produces incorrect results for `Callable`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to incorrect type narrowing for `isinstance` when the pre-narrowed type is a generic callable. This addresses #5881.

title: Type checking failures against numpy types

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to an incorrect type evaluation in certain cases where a type argument for a function call argument type is left unspecified (and is therefore assumed to be Unknown). This addresses #5879. (#5880)

title: class method reported as not accessed in strict mode
Type narrowing error in async function while return type mark as `NoReturn`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that led to a false positive error when determining whether the target of an awaited call is a `NoReturn`. This addresses #5876.

title: pyright-langserver uses different default for `useLibraryCodeForTypes`

fix_commits.subject: Changed the default of `useLibraryCodeForTypes` from false to true in the LSP settings. (It was changed to true in all other places previously, but this case was missed.) This addresses #5874.

title: TypeVarTuple and tuple[Any, ...]

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in a false positive error when assigning an unpacked TypeVarTuple to an unpacked `tuple[Any, ...]` in an invariant context. This addresses #5864.

title: `OrderedDict` and `Counter` being flagged when importing from `collections`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug in the recently-introduced `deprecateTypingAliases` feature that resulted in false positives when `OrderedDict` is imported from `collections`. This addresses #5859.

title: Cannot type `self` for overloads of enum methods

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false positive when an enum literal annotation is used within the enum class definition and `from __future__ import annotations` is in use. This addresses #5857.

title: More higher-order function type variable unification issues

fix_commits.subject: Further simplification of the logic involved in type var solving. (#8600)

title: Classes inheriting from NamedTuple can't be assigned to a relevant protocol

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that results in a false positive error during protocol matching when a NamedTuple is matched against a protocol using `_fields` or other attributes defined in the `NamedTuple` class. This addresses #5849.

title: Overriding method that takes in keyword-only argument with type parameter that appears in Callable annotation leads to incorrect reportIncompatibleMethodOverride

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false positive `reportIncompatibleMethodOverride` error when a function-scoped type variable was used in a covariant position. This addresses #5847.

title: Unknown type when using "identity"-type-functions on ParamSpec args/kwargs

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that led to the incorrect type evaluation when calling a generic function and a value of type `P.args` or `P.kwargs` is assigned to a type variable. This addresses #5845.

title: False positive reportUnusedVariable

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false positive `reportUnusedVariable` error when a dynamic expression was used in a `namedtuple` call argument. This addresses #5841.

title: reportUnknownMemberType not reported

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false negative error for an expression used within an f-string within a loop. This addresses #5839.

title: Faulty type variable unification in higher order function

fix_commits.subject: Added test case for #5838, which was already fixed by a previous change.

title: `tuple[T, ...]` should follow subtyping rules

fix_commits.subject: Changed interpretation of `...` forms of tuples to improve consistency and match mypy's behavior. The type `tuple[int, ...]` is now interpreted as the union of all tuples of length zero or more that contain only `int`. Because this is a union, assigning a value of this type to a tuple type with a known (specified) length is now considered a type violation. This addresses #5828. (#5829)

title: Incorrect handling of recursive ParamSpec use

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to incorrect type evaluation and false positive errors when a function with a ParamSpec was passed to another function with a ParamSpec. This addresses #5826. (#5827)

title: Improve error message when invariants don't match (e.g., due to parameter name mismatches)

fix_commits.subject: Improved error message for type incompatibility when type parameter is covariant or contravariant. This addresses #5822. (#5823)

title: Obsolete example in mypy comparison docs

fix_commits.subject: Updated mypy comparison documentation. This addresses #5818.

title: Experimental TypeGuard doesn't support `type` the same as original TypeGuard

fix_commits.subject: Reworked the logic for "strict type guard" positive and negative type narrowing. This addresses #5815. (#5831)

title: Experimental TypeGuard produces invalid results?
Unknown argument type when multiple generics passed to function

fix_commits.subject: Fixed regression that resulted in incorrect type evaluation and a spurious `reportUnknownArgumentType` error when calling the same constructor multiple times in a single call expression. This addresses #5804. (#5808)

title: Self attributes being identified as their parents when being accessed using cls from the classmethod

fix_commits.subject: Changed type evaluation behavior for a class variable that uses `Self` in its type definition. When accessed via a subclass (either through `cls` or `self`), the type is now assumed to be changed to `Self` of the child class. This makes pyright's behavior closer to mypy's in this case. It addresses #5803. (#5806)

title: Misleading reportMissingTypeStubs diagnostic message and documentation

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that caused a "py.typed" marker file to be ignored in a namespace package if the marker file is at the same directory level as the submodule being imported leading to a spurious `reportMissingTypeStubs` error. This addresses #5802.

title: Certain Unary expressions in match statements break parser

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug in the parser that led to a false positive syntax error when a `match` statement was followed by a `-` or `~` token. This addresses #5798.

title: `re.compile` receiving generically typed argument gives error

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false positive during overload matching when the arg type includes a union where one of the subtypes is a constrained TypeVar. This addresses #5794. (#5809)

title: Regression: Type inference fails on nested zip calls
Inferred Unknown in descriptor

fix_commits.subject: Changed logic for handling the `__get__` method of a descriptor so pyright more accurately models the runtime behavior when the descriptor is accessed through an object (as opposed to a class). Previously, pyright was modeling this as an `Any` value to avoid problems with type stubs that are not accurately modeling the runtime behavior, but this caused other unintended side effects. This addresses #5778. (#5787)

title: Type mismatch for two identical Union[*Ts] variables
Overriding __hash__ for Mapping class raises reportIncompatibleVariableOverride

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that led to a false positive `reportIncompatibleVariableOverride` error when overriding a synthesized `__hash__` symbol. This addresses #5771.

title: Constraint solver cannot find solution when union of "naked" type variables are used in parameter annotation

fix_commits.subject: Added heuristic to constraint solver logic to better handle the case where a parameter is annotated with a union of multiple "bare" TypeVars (like `S | T`). In this case, it's not clear whether the corresponding argument type should constrain `S` or `T` or both. We now defer the constraint during the first pass of arg/param type validation so additional references to `S` or `T` can help establish the appropriate constraint. This addresses #5768. (#5772)

title: Textual form of type that includes `...` for a ParamSpec value includes unnecessary parens

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in the incorrect textual form (used in error messages) for a generic class with a ParamSpec that is parameterized with `...`. This addresses #5758.

title: Incorrect narrowing on assignment when assigned value is class with `...` for ParamSpec specialization

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to incorrect type narrowing on assignment in certain cases. This addresses #5757. (#5761)

title: Warn when writing *args after a kwarg in calls

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that sometimes led to false positives or false negative in call expressions that involve keyword arguments followed by an unpacked. This addresses #5755.

title: Recent change makes Equatable protocol no longer work

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a recent regression that resulted in a false positive during protocol matching if the protocol defines an `__eq__` method but doesn't include a `__hash__` definition. This addresses #5753.

title: Overriding method that takes in *args and **kwargs from ParamSpec leads to incorrect reportIncompatibleMethodOverride.

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false positive in the `reportIncompatibleMethodOverride` check when overriding a method with a ParamSpec. This addresses #5750.

title: False negative when class derives from two generic base classes that conflict by type argument

fix_commits.subject: Added check for classes that have mutually-incompatible base classes due to generic type argument mismatches. This addresses #5748. (#5762)

title: Recursive coroutine call shows error

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in a false positive error when an `async` function with no return type annotation was called recursively. This addresses #5745.

title: Pylance does not report multiple assignments to name in match pattern.

fix_commits.subject: Improved detection of redundant pattern capture targets in `case` statements. This addresses #5742.

title: Pyright thinks that star imports overwrite the module docstring

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that can result in a false positive error when a wildcard import targets a module that doesn't contain a `__all__` definition but includes dundered names in its module namespace. This addresses #5737.

title: Callable assigned to field in enum is not treated as an enumerated type
PyLance/PyRight resolving to site-packages instead of local workspace files

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug in import resolver that caused a site-packages module to be preferred over a local module if the site-packages package is "py.typed". This addresses #5719.

title: Method decorated with @overload leads to incorrect reportIncompatibleMethodOverride when subclass overrides method and adds additional overload.

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false positive in the `reportIncompatibleMethodOverride` check in certain circumstances where the method in both the base class and child class are overloaded. This addresses #5718. (#5746)

title: Pylance false positive reportUnnecessaryComparison
`A is B` type guard narrows `type` incorrectly

fix_commits.subject: Fixed type narrowing bug that affected the `A is B` type narrowing pattern when `A` has the type `type`. This addresses #5714.

title: Binary operator that returns `NoReturn` is evaluated as invalid

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in incorrect type evaluation (and a false positive error) when a binary operator overload method was annotated to return `NoReturn`. This addresses #5711. (#5712)

title: False negative when using a TypeVar that is not bound to scope

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false negative when a TypeVar was used inappropriately in certain cases. This addresses #5710. (#5727)

title: Invalid syntax with walrus and yield not detected
False negative when using a TypeVar bound to a TypedDict
`dataclass` should exempt `__hash__` from field names
Regression: Coroutine result with `Unknown | None` resolved before await

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in incorrect type evaluation for an async function that has no type annotations. It was using call-site return type inference but failing to wrap the result in a `Coroutine`. This addresses #5705.

title: Symbols imported with wildcard import do not have types enforced

fix_commits.subject: Added type compatibility enforcement for symbols imported via a wildcard import. This addresses #5704. (#5728)

title: False negative when using keyword argument for `NamedTuple`

fix_commits.subject: Improved validation of `NamedTuple` and `namedtuple` factory calls. This addresses #5699. (#5739)

title: False positive for `functools.cached_property` on a union of enum members

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false positive when accessing a `cached_property` defined on an enum. This addresses #5696.

title: Unknown argument type with itemgetter

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in incorrect type evaluation when passing a generic class as a `Callable` parameter more than once in the same call. This addresses #5693.

title: Regression with chain
False positive inside list comprehension
isinstance type guard narrows type incorrectly when pre-narrowed type includes type variable

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug in the `isinstance` type guard logic that produced incorrect results when narrowing a generic class instance. This addresses #5688. (#5790)
Fixed a bug in the `isinstance` type guard logic that produced incorrect results when narrowing a generic class instance. This addresses #5688. (#5797)

title: Variance checks for parameter and return type parameters shouldn't apply to nested functions

fix_commits.subject: Fixed false positive where an inner function within a method uses a TypeVar to annotate its parameter. The variance of the TypeVar shouldn't be checked in this case, whereas it should be for the method. This addresses #5687.

title: Property on metaclass should take precedence over property on class

fix_commits.subject: Added logic to mirror the (rather surprising) runtime behavior when an attribute is accessed from a class object and the metaclass defines an attribute of the same name that happens to be a descriptor object. The runtime favors the metaclass attribute in this case. This addresses #5686. (#5774)

title: False positive when using two-argument form of `super`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that led to a false positive when a two-argument form of a `super` call used `type` as the first argument. This addresses #5685.

title: False positive when empty tuple is used in `except` statement

fix_commits.subject: Fixed false positive error when an empty tuple was used in an `except` statement. This addresses #5684.

title: Fields in a NamedTuple are implicitly read-only for purposes of protocol matching

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug in protocol matching that led to an incorrect protocol match with a NamedTuple. Fields in a NamedTuple are implicitly read-only, so a writable protocol should not match. This addresses #5683.

title: False Positive Union Protocol Compatibility

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression that led to a false positive when assigning a union of types that use invariant type parameters to a protocol that uses a covariant type parameter. This addresses #5673. (#5675)

title: False positive of "reportIncompatibleMethodOverride" when multi inheritance is involved
Async function return value inlay hint error

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in an incorrect hover type (and inlay hint) for the inferred return type of an `async` function or method. This addresses #5639. (#5647)

title: Type inference failing in recent versions
"Argument type partially unknown" in calls to `str.translate` and `str.maketrans`
overloaded function passed into function with ParamSpec error
Incorrect type narrowing on assignment when assigned type has invariant type param and target type contains `Any`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to incorrect type narrowing on assignment in certain cases where the declared type includes a type argument with an `Any` and the assigned type does not. This addresses #5628. (#5671)

title: Enum introspection issue
Crash in flownode (about 50 hits in 2023.7.40 Pylance release)

fix_commits.subject: Added more complete logging for assertion failure that shows up in telemetry. This is related to #5622.
Fixed a condition in the code flow engine that corrupted internal state and led to a crash. This addresses #5622. (#5702)

title: Argument of type "list[str]" cannot be assigned to parameter "__iterable" of type "Iterable[SupportsRichComparisonT@sorted]" in function "sorted"
Report unbound for deferred imported variable
[verifytypes] Possible regression when analysing a generic class with a type attached leading to unknown types
Builtins are not defined if "inject==5.0.0" is present in the environment
`collections.OrderdDict` causes file analysis to hang
v1.1.319 appears to be broken on Node.js v12
type Typevar bound interaction

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in a false positive error when attempting to assign a TypeVar `T` that has a bound of `type` to an expression `type[S]`. This addresses #5581. (#5591)

title: Missing Narrowing for class defined with a decorator applied
Pattern Matching with type()
Errors reported when using AnyStr.join(Iterable[AnyStr])

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false positive when a constrained type variable was used as a type argument in an annotation for an argument passed to a method that's bound to the same type variable. This addresses #5556. (#5557)

title: Conditional bases not inherited properly

fix_commits.subject: Improved robustness of handling of circular dependencies for class evaluations. This addresses #5554. (#5558)

title: Bad `dict` type inference when assigning `{}` to a dict-like `Protocol` that has `Union` values

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false positive error when using bidirectional type inference for a dictionary expression when the expected type is a protocol. This addresses #5552. (#5562)

title: Possibly unbound symbols are assumed to be bound in certain cases

fix_commits.subject: Fixed an inconsistency in reporting of unbound variables when the variable is captured by an inner scope. The new behavior correctly identifies unbound (or potentially unbound) variables in cases where the captured variable is narrowed. This happens when there are no assignments to the variable after it is captured. This addresses #5548. (#5551)
fix_commits.body:
Fixed a bug in type narrowing for captured variables. Captured variables that are modified in other scopes using a `nonlocal` or `global` binding should be ineligible for type narrowing.

Co-authored-by: Eric Traut <erictr@microsoft.com>

title: ParamSpec/Type in Type[Callable[P,T]] binds to params of __init__, not __call__ for callable classes.
FATAL ERROR: Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a hang and eventual crash (due to memory exhaustion) under certain circumstances where a function returns a generic `Callable` whose type parameters are not used in the input parameters for the function. This addresses #5540. (#5565)

title: False negative when union type is used in an invariant context

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that led to a false negative when determining type compatibility between two unions in an invariant context. This addresses #5534. (#5536)

title: Unable to bind contextmanager methods inside classmethods

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in a false positive when an expression of type `type[Self]` was used as the base type for a member access expression that was then used to call an instance method on that class. This addresses #5530. (#5532)

title: False positive reportOverlappingOverload for constrained TypeVar

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that resulted in a false positive `reportOverlappingOverload` error when overload contained the use of a constrained TypeVar. This addresses #5511. (#5512)

title: Composition of curried composition
Does not correctly narrow down `val: Any | None` by `val is not None`.

fix_commits.subject: Modified `is None` type guard logic to eliminate `Any` or `Unknown` in the positive narrowing case. This addresses #5508. (#5509)

title: assigning __init_subclass__ to an existing function

fix_commits.subject: Added additional special-case handling for `__init_subclass__` and `__class_getitem__` to treat them as implicit class methods even if they are not declared using a `def` statement. This addresses #5500.

title: Cannot solve the correct generic type from the usages when the `ParamSpec` contains generic types.

fix_commits.subject: Added support within the constraint solver for higher-order functions that accept a callable parameterized with a ParamSpec where the passed callable is generic. This addresses #5495. (#5567)

title: Matching Any with *sequence pattern produces unexpected reports

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug in type narrowing for pattern matching in the negative (fall-through) case when the subject type contains an `Any`. This addresses #5492. (#5499)

title: Tuple unpacking in enums is not handled properly

fix_commits.subject: Added special-case support for enum fields that are assigned using an unpacked tuple operation. This addresses #5458. (#5460)

title: Potential regression with generic descriptors (v1.1.314 -> v1.1.315)

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression that resulted in a false positive error when using bidirectional type inference for an assignment to a class-scoped variable where the annotated type is a descriptor. This addresses #5455. (#5519)

title: Calling functions that use a ParamSpec as arguments multiple times in another function call gives incorrect parameter errors

fix_commits.subject: Issue5453 5454 (#5461)
fix_commits.body:
* Fixed bug that resulted in false positive error when calling the same generic function with a ParamSpec multiple times as separate arguments within a call expression. This addresses #5453.

* Fixed another ParamSpec-related issue. This addresses #5454.

---------

Co-authored-by: Eric Traut <erictr@microsoft.com>

title: Multiple Paramspecs inside same call expression, second one fails binding

fix_commits.subject: Issue5453 5454 (#5461)
fix_commits.body:
* Fixed bug that resulted in false positive error when calling the same generic function with a ParamSpec multiple times as separate arguments within a call expression. This addresses #5453.

* Fixed another ParamSpec-related issue. This addresses #5454.

Co-authored-by: Eric Traut <erictr@microsoft.com>

title: File Analysis Too Slow

fix_commits.subject: Added code to handle pathological case in unannotated code that writes to the same variable hundreds of times with different types. This mitigates the performance problem reported in #5475. (#5493)

title: Regression: `Type of "get" is partially unknown` for final TypeDicts

fix_commits.subject: Fixed recent regression in the synthesized TypedDict `get` method, which resulted in a false positive error when using strict mode. This addresses #5452. (#5462)

title: False negative when a variable is used within the type expression passed as first argument to `cast` call
Unknown return type when using method on Union of generics

fix_commits.subject: Fixed an issue in type evaluation of call expressions where the callable subexpression evaluates to a union, and the callable subtypes have different signatures. Pyright was previously caching the types from the first subtype, so it didn't re-evaluate using the second subtype (which may require bidirectional type inference). This addresses #5428. (#5547)

title: Namedtuple: unnecessary/incorrect error report (reportGeneralTypeIssues)

fix_commits.subject: Added detection of errors when a namedtuple definition includes a language keyword. Also added minimal support for the `rename` parameter to the `namedtuple` function. This addresses #5423. (#5482)

title: Hover shows type of `Unknown` for object passed as value to unspecialized `dict`

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that resulted in incorrect hover results for identifiers used as keys or values within a dictionary expression. This addresses #5422. (#5466)

title: False positive in overload checking: `type "(**P@f) -> R@f" cannot be assigned to type "(**P@f) -> R@f"`
Watch mode repeatedly prints `Error returned from file system watcher.` when virtual env is inside the directory being analyzed
Wrong return type for `dict.fromkeys`

fix_commits.subject: Modified the heuristics used for narrowing on assignment when the assigned type contains an `Any`. If the target's declared type does not contain `Any`, the assignment shouldn't produce an `Any` within the resulting type. This addresses #5413. (#5566)

title: Strange behavior when explicit annotation is given to AsyncGenerator

fix_commits.subject: Fixed bug that led to a confusing hover type for the return result of an async generator function. This addresses #5411. (#5468)

title: typevar bindings disappear in "indirect" proxy

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a bug that results in incorrect type evaluation for a higher-order function involving a ParamSpec. This addresses #5409. (#5469)

title: Intermediate variable is needed for construct-typing
Regression: False positive - TypeVars aren't bound to 'Unknown' when non-subscripted type is passed to function

fix_commits.subject: Fixed a recent regression that resulted in unsolved type arguments when a "bare" generic class (like `dict`) is passed as an argument to a function that accepts a `type[T]`. This addresses #5392. (#5494)

fix_commits.subject: Fixed long-standing bug that caused various problems (including poor performance, incorrect type evaluations, and false negatives and false positives) when calling a constructor for a generic class within the class implementation. This addresses #5373. (#5836)

fix_commits.body:
Rollup of:

- Ensure pyright builds with TypeScript 4.1's RC.
- Add tmpfile creation to the FS abstraction.
- Add infrastructure for supporting source mapping to generated source code (i.e. scraping); used in Pylance in a prototype phase for builtins, but may be moved here once we figure that all out.
- Add a parse tree util to check if inside a type comment.
- Ensure paths are rooted relative to workspaces when needed (#1052).
